name: Voter Action Project
subject: Registering more voters can be the whole ballgame
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Our voter registration work doesn't end, folks.
Despite vote-suppressing state legislatures making it harder to register to vote -- passing bills to stop organizations like ours and our partners on the ground from helping potential voters navigate the increasingly murky rules around voter registration -- we're still pulling out all the stops to bring voters into the system.
Voter registration is a critical part of grassroots efforts to protect voting rights. The more people who vote, the more our government looks like we, the people. But to get to the point where every voice is heard, we need your help .
Just $3 can help us register a new voter. Will you chip in $12 or more today to help register 4 new voters? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=101525_3&amount=12]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=101525_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=101525_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=101525_3&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=101525_3&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?express_lane=true&refcode=101525_3&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=101525_3&amount=36]
Voter participation has been increasing, and young people -- a major target of opponents of voting rights -- see the importance of voting now more than ever. Voting quickly becomes a habit -- a habit our democracy sorely needs to fulfill the promise of the American dream. Overwhelming key states with new voter registrations can help turn the tide against the voter suppression laws we've seen passed the last few years.
The next election will determine whether our democracy stays mired in the darkness and conspiracy theories we hear every day or if we can reclaim our rights -- from voting to choice and more -- and march forward to a better future.
New voter registration -- at just about $3 per new voter -- can make a huge difference. Please, can you pitch in with $12 or whatever you can to help us register a wave of new voters ahead of this year's registration deadlines? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-voterregistration?refcode=101525_3&amount=12]
Thank you,
Voter Action Project's Registration Team

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

Trump talks a lot of game about his ability to make a deal, but when it’s time to put those words into action, he doesn’t even show up to the bargaining table.
It’s been more than two weeks since the government shutdown began, and he still has yet to put ANY work into negotiating a bipartisan solution.
Trump and Republicans are trying to blame Democrats, but I believe most Americans — especially Virginians — see what’s really happening here: Republicans have control over the White House, the House of Representatives, and the Senate.
So, why did Senate Republicans block our bill to fix their health care mess and fund the government?
Because Trump told them to.
Why are House Republicans refusing to even start conversations with Democrats?
Because Trump ordered them not to negotiate.
Why did Speaker Johnson shut down the House weeks ago — and why is he still refusing to bring it back into session in the middle of a shutdown?
Because Trump demanded they block a vote to make the Epstein files public.
Republicans run this government — and at the end of the day, they all do Trump’s bidding. This is Trump’s shutdown, and this is Trump’s mess.
Over the weekend I talked with a lot of Virginians who are deeply worried about how this shutdown is hurting their families. And what I heard over and over was that this pain didn’t start two weeks ago — it started when Trump returned to the White House.
From the layoffs, to the clawbacks of federal public health funding, to the cancellation of economic development projects — this has been Trump’s plan from day one. He said he wanted to traumatize federal employees, and he’s made good on that promise.
So what can we do?
Keep the pressure on. We make sure Trump and Republicans know that the American people aren’t buying their lies and finger-pointing.
We’ve seen public outrage work when it comes to pressuring Trump and his administration into action — so now is the time to stand up and speak out against this reckless shutdown.
Tell President Trump and his GOP: Open the government, save health care, and do your jobs. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/KDBho97lBkCc6EKZfg3y1Q2]
More updates to come,
Tim Kaine

| | Friend,

I have big news to share. **Congressman Matt Gaetz, Wayne Allyn Root, and Nevada Republican Party Chairman Michael McDonald** will join me at my official campaign launch event on **Saturday, October 25th, at Fervent Cavalry Chapel** in Las Vegas.

This campaign isn’t just about one race. It’s about taking back our country, restoring conservative leadership, and **flipping Nevada’s 4th District** from Steven Horsford and the radical left. For too long, Horsford has voted with radical Democrats and the Washington insiders, pushing policies that have hurt Nevada families and weakened our nation. It’s time for that to change.

These conservative champions know what it looks like to fight back against the radical left, and I am proud to have them on our team! They have stood up to the corrupt establishment, exposed the weaponization of government, and defended our freedoms when others backed down. I’m proud to have him standing with me as we launch this campaign to bring accountability and strength back to Washington.

I need your support from day one to build the momentum we need to win. Join us for an evening of energy, patriotism, and purpose as we send a message loud and clear: **Nevada’s 4th District is ready for change.**

We have a real opportunity to bring real, positive, conservative change to Nevada, but it will take all of us working together. **I am matching every single dollar that is being donated, so your donation will have 2X the impact! Will you join our movement to flip NV-04?**

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Pam Bondi told me she would fire me if she could
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Team —

Attorney General Pam Bondi appeared at her first oversight hearing after nine months of her stewardship of the Justice Department.

It was urgent — after all, hundreds of career prosecutors have quit because of the politicization of the Justice Department and the fear that they might have to take unethical actions at the direction of Trump and Bondi.

We’ve seen the DOJ cover up the corruption of the administration and its friends — like the WH Border Czar taking $50,000 in cash from undercover FBI agents. Or the corruption case against the Mayor of NYC. Or the Epstein files.

And we’ve seen the department prosecute the president’s enemies at the president’s urging — like James Comey — even though career prosecutors said the case lacked evidence.

Team, it’s safe to say Pam Bondi was not too pleased with my line of questioning. Don’t just take it from me, look at some of the headlines from the hearing: [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94720?t=6&akid=21490%2E878179%2E15rbzd) Friend, the Department of Justice has become Trump’s personal sword to go after his ever-growing list of political enemies, including me. And his shield to cover up corruption and hide wrongdoing.

And Pam Bondi has enabled this behavior.

Instead of going after Tom Homan, Trump’s border czar, for taking the 50 thousand in cash, the DOJ shut down the investigation.

When I asked Attorney General Bondi about this, she deflected responsibility. Said she didn’t know or wouldn’t comment about the case. She said that I should be **fired.** _Folks, she even said I should apologize to Donald Trump for leading his first impeachment trial.

Not gonna happen._

The Department of Justice should be pursuing accountability, cracking down on corruption, and defending the Constitution. But under this administration, the DOJ is a tool for attacking enemies and covering up wrongdoing.

I will continue to use my position on the Judiciary Committee to conduct hard oversight and demand concrete answers. I will call out corruption and speak out against any and every attempt to weaponize our legal system against Trump’s political opponents. I will not give in, and not back down.

[Please, help me and the Voter Protection Project stand up to this corruption — pitch in to our work demanding accountability.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94720?t=7&akid=21490%2E878179%2E15rbzd) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Adam Schiff and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/94721?t=8&akid=21490%2E878179%2E15rbzd)

subject: What’s “essential”? Here’s what really matters.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Elizabeth Guzman
clean_body: When Republicans talk about “essential services,” they don’t mean for you. | | | Friend — When Republicans talk about “essential services,” they don’t mean for you. They mean****ballroom renovations, corporate tax breaks, and kickbacks for their donors , even while shutting down the government and leaving working families wondering when their next paycheck will come. Elizabeth Guzman knows what essential really means. ✅ Teachers. Because every child deserves a fair shot. ✅ Nurses. Because our communities can’t run without care. ✅ Public workers.** Because government isn’t the problem. The problem is the people who sabotage it. As a social worker, immigrant, and mom, Elizabeth’s spent her life fighting for those essential workers, the ones who keep Virginia running even when politicians play games. But her opponent, Ian Lovejoy, voted with the far right to slash funding for special education schools, health care, and public safety — then called his own salary essential. Let’s remind them who this government really serves. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. Because you know what’s the most essential thing of all? Leaders who never forget who they work for.** Thanks for joining us today. — Team Guzman | Democrat is running for Delegate in Virginia's 22nd District. name: AOC
subject: I just finished a CNN town hall with Bernie
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Republicans are making a foolish mistake by saying they think that making investments in housing and energy are so-called 'Democrat priorities.'
Cutting the EPA as a 'Democrat priority.' Do you know what this country looked like before the EPA?
Rivers in rural areas were _on fire_ because of corporations poisoning the people who lived in those areas. Poor, middle-class communities getting poisoned and dumped on by corporations — like Deloitte and 3M — pouring chemicals into these places.
Well, you know what?
**You're damn well right that it's a Democratic priority to keep people from getting poisoned** by identifying dangerous chemicals that are being dumped and causing cancer in people without their knowledge.
**You're damn right that it's a Democratic priority to bring down the cost of housing** , and mortages, and rent.
**And you're damn right that it's a Democratic priority to raise the minimum wage in this country** to allow people to get a fair shot at the American dream.
If they want to say that's a 'Democratic priority' — they're right. And they are targeting all of us with this.
And it's important for us to remember that these priorities are actually _not partisan at all_.
They think all of this is about hurting Democrats — but what they are doing is choosing to hurt _Americans_.
We cannot allow it. Our movement will have to push back harder than ever.

body:

The Democrats haven’t had much to celebrate recently.

_**CNN:

name: Jessica Hamilton, Evergreen
subject: ICYMI: Join us to learn what we do now to support clean energy
body:
Defending and delivering clean energy progress in every community
| | |
---
| Hi—

I wanted to make sure you saw Lena’s invitation to our webinar on how we can defend and deliver clean energy in every community, even as important federal tax incentives expire soon. **It’s happening TODAY at 12 p.m. ET / 9 a.m. PT. Can you join us?**

[**Sign up here to join us alongside an incredible lineup of voices in the clean energy sector**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4096384/87SdQ4wZ), and read more details below.

Looking forward to it,

Jessica Hamilton
Senior Director of Digital Advocacy
Evergreen Collaborative

\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Lena Moffitt, Evergreen Collaborative
Date: Fri, Oct 10, 2025
Subject: JOIN US: what we do now to support clean energy |
| [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4096385/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi there,

The transition to a thriving clean energy future is at a crossroads. Across the country, families are wiring their homes for a cleaner, cheaper future while neighbors are working together to bring larger clean energy projects to life in their communities.

At the same time, Trump’s disastrous budget law is eliminating tax credits that make this clean energy switch affordable, and many federal incentives for these projects have new deadlines that expire soon.

To learn more about what’s at stake and what opportunities for progress still exist at the state level, please join me **next Thursday, October 16, at 12 p.m. ET / 9 a.m. PT** for a conversation with _Here Comes the Sun_ author Bill McKibben and the founders of Rewiring America and Greenlight America. We’ll talk about what state leaders and advocates can do right now to power our clean energy future. [**Can you make it?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4096386/87SdQ4wZ) |
| [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4096387/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
[YES, COUNT ME IN](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4096388/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| **During this panel-style conversation, you’ll learn:**
* What homeowners, renters, and advocates can do before the federal rebate window closes.
* How state and local leaders can sustain momentum with new programs and policies.
* Why local clean energy projects are stalling—and how to change this.
* Where decision-makers and advocates can work together to keep the clean energy transition moving.

|
---
| We’ll also have plenty of time for Q&A and will share the recording afterwards.

**The next few months will be decisive for how fast our nation’s clean energy progress accelerates or stalls** —and as we know, speed is everything when it comes to tackling the climate crisis. [**I hope you’ll join me next Thursday for this important conversation.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4096389/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[RSVP TODAY](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/4096390/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| In solidarity, |
---
| | |
---
### Lena Moffitt
Executive Director
Evergreen Collaborative

---

---

## Shutdown Deepens as Judge Halts Layoffs
A federal judge in San Francisco on Wednesday [blocked the Trump administration from firing](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGuqzAQRVcDndF4ICYpXPyGLr99JTJ4DJMYO7JNUHb_RLbwupFG9-ie-3Mf74Y9h-W_2UgXF8dAR_ZUCqXRm090Lk8-zk-ya9wzxeA40YiAFyFBSDVaw_4zdrXVjgiprUnLXoGC661t61Ubi8pBd0WYsL8Y25Kx6tbO1t0u8qpczfqkSZBKAqDEhnoENU_z1CkAg13VAVkuMTWPyKGs5Pwnvik1c9xqr9dSXrlq_1U4VDgcx9HMUz4tzn-Fw3lWOCxnJGwUisjrXmw8gnjsdiHx9cuipH17CWM3DpxLMoVjEI4Th0UcMT0pnZg6afs62HvOqq86WDbD_tuk_Gm-t8bfAAAA__88GIe7) thousands of federal workers during the ongoing shutdown, calling the layoffs politically motivated and illegal. The standoff, [now in its third week](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGynDAMhk9jOhhZgL0ULtLQvbQpGYPlxYlBO7Z3GW6fcSY3eI3mK6RP0v_ra_myIYbz-dMeZIrn5aQrRyqF0hLtzd7nNfL2h9zO70x8-pBoQcCxldBKtTgb4r0MjTOeCKlvyEitQMFj6vtmN-M6atp6sispDVKjtBLt1KOX0_AAbIKpNglSSQCU2JFGUNu6rYMCsDiIAciFwqn7zeEsO_l484dSt_HRRLOX8sqi_yFwFjhf19W9sy3s7F0bBM65cLoFzvUzgfOLYyhhq1gXC5wl1FLJk6NkY_us_vOgs7R5fxfH19k6e7dybHkrvFKq-H_8odQktUQALXBuknGvK8QYstJigOdhQ_x3avlWvh-DfwMAAP__kVuLEQ), continues as the Senate again failed to pass a funding bill on Tuesday, with Democrats pushing to extend Affordable Care Act health insurance subsidies and Republicans refusing to tie the issue to the budget. Meanwhile, President Trump redirected $8 billion of unused Pentagon funds to pay military salaries, saying the government would take care of our troops. GOP leaders in Congress [surprised Democrats](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO4yAUheGngc4RXGMcFxTbuMu2W1oYLuHuYLCAJMrbjzKvMPWRPun8_27bzVKifP9rDzQ9lC3jqyXsHeuW7LuE0PZU3Bf6WB4NSw5UcQMB0yDFIPXmLaX3prg3ARFw5GjkrIUW12UceTQ-aHnVMDpEWMRuZ6nDopy7zqDVrj0n89GkkFoKARIuOIPQbne70kJYUEwJ9NRLvfwvlHvEkN7lifXiysGTib2fjY1_GKwM1h4xUkqfjcEay4GfQwzWhtl2ZLBO06SnBYYeHxkHjwFzw8GeZy1nJdup5DbslBKDlVfjzxelRE3PTIn7YenH5v1XsZ4GvgMAAP__Yst-TQ) by bringing the $852 billion defense appropriation bill up for a vote today during the shutdown. Meanwhile, House Minority Leader [Hakeem Jeffries and Speaker Mike Johnson](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO6yAQheGnwR3RMGDsFBS3cZfbbmlhM4RJsIkMmyhvv8q-wtZH-qTzf13mi-fM-_W_38i1WOadXjVTa3TM2b9LjHXJZb1TSOW7UtkjHzQjYC8VSGXn4Dm_Z9MFF4mQdEdODRYsjGetu-SWEcZzHEbQJoTFjtBj0MrE1RCCIujYfTQFyioAVHiiAcGuy7oYC-DRCAMUuJXjdCu8t0Qxv8uTjtNati671NqjCv1P4CRwaokS5_zZBE6pbPQ5JHDq-95qpWXyd6JN3ijGg6nKje8kbyXttewy0OIbCZy6w4XHi3Pmagdh4Lp5_kW79qdKT4c_AQAA__9cY3sK) agreed to debate the shutdown live on C-SPAN, as nearly 900,000 federal workers remain furloughed and key national landmarks stay closed with no deal in sight.
## Risks Grow as Earth's Magnetic Field Weakens
A growing dent in Earth’s magnetic field, known as the [South Atlantic Anomaly](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFu4zAQRU8jdWOMSEb2Fiq2cZdttxRG5JCaDUUa5CSCb79wrpD2P-Dj4f19X99JspT0hw5eNNa18Nkzq3JbMz1rjH3L1X9w2Otn51qiNF4NmjeYEKZ5DST5uboxLJHZsB15ma4zznj7Ze24L7h5jP52DXZ2N3yLZAMGZ1ywzrK9TaMsr7cJp3lCNJO58NXg7De_uRmRjBscchCt7fKvStGdY37WL24XX48xL7vqow_292Dug7mf53npD_L8ooO5U9dWSz2eg7kzNd1fGyShonAyfUB_VAUp8A07HJQKq3iIwjmAdEisKiXBJilxAyoBRMHXzxxgY9gowKsZxNqgk3LOotzHtoTHKTlLn6-Dw3SQ5G9j_VHmr8X8DwAA__86iZS6), has expanded by an area half the size of Europe over the past decade, according to new satellite data. Stretching between South America and Africa, the anomaly has [significantly grown since 2014](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDEOnDAQAF8DnZG9GDgKF2muu7QpkbHXsLnFPtkOiN9Hly-kH41G8-u1vCwxxe2nPdDUkJaIV2GsFfPC9k4hlJWTe6Pf05-CKQbKuICEQSgp1Lh4S3wvuvUmIAL2LRo1jXKUj7nv291MelJDGKTyDgG0cxoeM0794Gbt5xVaMl-bkmpUUoKCDieQo1vdqkcpLehGS_RUU-5-J4p1x8B3OjF3Lh0tm73WT2n6Hw08G3he19UVRxgdWsZcv1ADz9OWKmxMh-VbUBRoc92LOOwWsZITgZC9eCN-ithyuihuotiKzFSxiIwnWm6z8Z-LmKmMU6PldljifxX1v9adBv4GAAD__4A0hb8), raising concerns for satellites, astronauts, and high-altitude flights due to increased radiation exposure. Scientists believe that shifting flows of molten iron beneath the Earth’s surface, possibly influenced by a massive subterranean “hot blob” under Africa, are warping the Earth's magnetic field. [Watch a short documentary here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFu6yAUxvGngS3W4UCwMzBc6SpbKnXqiDAcYlpiUpsY-e0r9xW6_j_pN3wfN3tzKaf5_uYeZGosdqa2ZqqVFpvdXmJcx1z8F4WpvFYqc0wLWQQ8nwSchLbBpbxbxYOJREiSkxG9Bg3DRUo-GaEuA8JFOe11GERwUQUfAQUO7jyKnidzaAKEFnDkjnoE7Uc_Kg3gUDEFFFItS_dZ0lwninkvGy2dLw-ezVTrc2XyH8Mrw2trrdvLq75GOvajuOonJq8bk_-_n-HdN3vGdOOLCc-Wck6r7pmC-8Ol_EvWP_2wGfwJAAD__-wrcPI).
## Halloween ‘Burning House’ Rings Alarms
A South Carolina couple’s [hyper-realistic Halloween setup](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGu4yAQheGnsTsiGBPsLSi2SZdtt7QIDPHsjhkLSKK8_VXuK9z6SEef_r_X9RqIqdz_hB19z7IWfDXG3rGuHN6Sc7uxxP-YNnk0lJKp4goazspoZdyaAvF7tWPyGRFwGtGb2Wmnl1_TNG4-JrdYE82UnFt0XvKSgo5wRju7FF0ayX_ejDbOaA0GTjiDdvEWb9ZpHcAOVmOiLvX0T6j0DTO_5Yn1FGUf2W-9H22Yfg9wGeByoByMn2mAy8eqEh6h9h1LV1QeJYWOScXA3FTFQ2qncleb7Kgyhx2b2gKzvBCLIuZHIynKmAVmB3asPh0vYqbm5sHq-x6Ivx39R_GeHr4CAAD__5_LhZY), complete with smoke and lighting effects that mimic a house fire, has prompted multiple 911 calls from worried passersby. Amanda Peden and her fiancé, former Mayor Sam Lee, say the illusion runs each night from 8 to 10 p.m. through Oct. 31 in Fountain Inn, and they’ve posted warnings online [asking people not to call the fire department](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAUAL8GO83jiagFxTV2e-2VBuGxcoewAXaNf3_Z-4WrJ5lJ5uu23rQPPt4_9UGqurRGOkugWimvQV_JubKFZH7I7ulZKEXnM60IOLQcWi5Xq324VtFY5YiQ-oYUHyVImOa-b3YlRgc4CNomRwPH2VqcBoEgOJhpNn3j1dvGgUsOgBw7GhGk2cwmJIBGwQSQ9TXl7jv5WHdy4Uovyp1JRxPUXuujsP6D4cJwOc-zq8nq600ZLg-dKdbCcHH68OFiuGzPHH28t3s6qN11COkkiq0lk7KuPsXSZhM19sM8yyYr-zh9CL7IkQm4H9qHv3L9166Xwt8AAAD__0xqf0Y). Despite prior notice, fire crews still respond to each report out of caution. While many praise the spooky spectacle, some critics say it looks too real and should be regulated. State Rep. name: Russell Cleveland for U.S. House MT-01
subject: 26,000 Miles. One Message: We Deserve Better Than “Good Enough.”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CLEVELAND FOR CONGRESSP
body:
26,000 miles. Dozens of towns. One message: it’s time to come back to the table and fight for each other again.

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://russellcleveland.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7cef8d6a1da540dae5618949&id=7e02a0e2b0&e=375cee343b)
| |
**The Heartbeat of Cleveland for Congress**
---
| | | | | |
Russell Cleveland has now traveled over 26,000 miles across Montana’s 1st District. That is more miles than driving around the world! He could have seen the Eiffel Tower, sat on a beach in Spain, or enjoyed a sunset in Hawaii. Instead, he chose to spend those 26,000 miles listening to Montanans and fighting for a future that works for everyone.
For too long, politics has been about voting _against_ something.
This campaign is about what we’re _for._
Russ knows the frustration that many of us feel and is all too familiar with the fear of what kind of future our kids will inherit if we don’t change course. But more importantly, he believes in hope.
Hope that together, we can set aside political extremism and come back to the kitchen table to ask what’s best for our neighbors, our kids, and ourselves, not just for the select few.
That’s the heartbeat of Cleveland for Congress.
Because Montana deserves better than “good enough.”
Now, as we head into Quarter 4, we need your help to keep this momentum going strong. Grassroots campaigns like ours depend on people, not corporations, to power every mile, every conversation, and every new supporter we meet.
[Will you help pitch in to fund the future for our next generation? Better yet, help pitch in to make the future possible now. Some of us don’t have time to wait for change and contributing to this campaign that stands for people, not corporations, will fight to make that future happen.](https://russellcleveland.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7cef8d6a1da540dae5618949&id=8835f94b7e&e=375cee343b)

Be a part of something better than extremism. Be a part of Cleveland for Congress.
-Team Cleveland

subject: God is moving
body:
[unsubscribe](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xul=o5pvyewrzrxe8xiau9slbgewyq7s2jhzyy3j66aww93pc9sf544psidykhjwt5lvp3o30xjdhnjjlqmlxkrdwtlcjamfhawdrmsz71b&__stmp=t4859b&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)

Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *
| | | | [](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?xtl=edb8w7bac24tlf04fg8snp39xegcfm3cxoax3k32oldkig3n4l6gdk91nlsh9amd3gba6pr1gnrswu3xwwd0dqq6a32k2afr73qmd3ocv90rh7c8l9sihvbvrsfytc6r2ygbekzt0&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.mg.swampdigest.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t4859b&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏
---

Phoenix, Arizona 85044

subject: Dark Nightmares
body:
I've been having nightmares recently that are dark beyond description. Terrifying. One occurred at 3:30 in the morning on the day that Charlie was killed. In one nightmare, a landline phone next to my bed rang. I answered, and on the other end was some demon, the most haunting voice I've heard in my life, saying, "I'm in your basement."

| | [****](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z7ragk8qg04ts8v8p0f1dq1r6r93937574f7ub00_rp22sh2s8i6eor0cdj62o34c1h2bs) [****](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ztne9m6qvq134iaae390v739eo7sf9b3mq64a7c8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0cdj62o34c1h2bs) Dear Patriot,

I've been having nightmares recently that are dark beyond description. Terrifying. One occurred at 3:30 in the morning on the day that Charlie was killed.

In one nightmare, a landline phone next to my bed rang. I answered, and on the other end was **some demon** , the most haunting voice I've heard in my life, saying, "**I'm in your basement.** "

I sat up immediately, not knowing if it was real or a dream. My hands ran alongside my bed to feel the fabric in the darkness. It took some time to recognize that I was awake. I looked at my nightstand, and there was no phone.

Those who know much more about God and the Devil than I do say that this is an example of spiritual warfare. They tell me that it's meant to terrify me, to make me question myself and my own sanity. **These nightmares, this evil, come just before a story OMG will be breaking that I believe will expose evil in a way we've never seen before**.

The story was placed on hold due to the shock and grief we've all felt for Charlie Kirk. I used to run stories by Charlie to get his feedback. I relayed our next release to Charlie before he was shot. It was the last text Charlie Kirk ever sent me. I prefer to keep the message private, but he understood the significance of the story and that **it strikes at the heart of evil in our nation.**

I'm reluctant to "hype" stories anymore. That's not my intent. But I am asking for your help.

First, I'm humbly asking for your prayers for me and OMG's staff. If you're a believer, I don't need to say anything else, other than "thank you."

Secondly, [**your support is needed**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ze0ukfe7oq5tcguhmjf3ui2f9rmg1sphjd2nlei0_rp22sh2s8i6eor0cdj62o34c1h2bs). [**Any amount that you can contribute is appreciated**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6771g131l655j4urka3voji8ud8b6pb4vtr6t50_rp22sh2s8i6eor0cdj62o34c1h2bs).

This story was one of our least expensive to produce, and you'll see why when it comes out. But it will open the floodgates of truth, and we need to be prepared for that. This story has the potential to change the world, but that's not up to me. OMG, reports the truth, the world decides. But I would be negligent in my duties if we're not prepared to deal with a flood of high-level whistleblowers after this release. And that's where your support is needed. [**Please, donate whatever you can today**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zi0938o3spf122cmhneaaph7ogoab9rsho489458_rp22sh2s8i6eor0cdj62o34c1h2bs).

Thank you again for all that you do and, as always, stay tuned.

In Truth, James O'Keefe

O'Keefe Media Group

| Friends-
Fall in Virginia is one of the most beautiful times of the year; the leaves are changing colors in the mountains, the air is crisp (but not too crisp), and everywhere you look, carved pumpkins and fall decorations are popping up on people's lawns. We love the changing colors, but what we love even more are the hardworking Virginians who live, work, and love in our beautiful Commonwealth. We want EVERY Virginian to be able to get ahead and thrive.
That's why we keep fighting for affordability measures like a Prescription Drug Affordability Board, Paid Family & Medical Leave, affordable housing, and a fair tax system. As President of Guy Chemical Company, Guy turned a small start-up in western Pennsylvania into a thriving manufacturing enterprise that now exports products around the world. His story is a testament to grit, ingenuity, and the power of American small business.
For decades, Guy has been a tireless voice for domestic manufacturing, workforce development, and pro-growth policies that keep good jobs here at home. He's worked closely with national and state leaders to highlight how local businesses--especially in rural communities--are essential to rebuilding the American Dream.
At his core, Guy believes that prosperity begins with **responsibility, opportunity, and faith** --values that mirror the heartbeat of _Seed & Roots_.
> "If we want to see America thrive again, we have to invest in people--our workers, our students, our families," Guy often says. "They're the real infrastructure of this country."
At the _Seed & Roots Summit 2025_, Guy Berkebile will speak to the future of small business and manufacturing in an era defined by rapid technological change, reshoring, and renewed interest in American production.
🗓 **Saturday, October 25, 2025**
📍 **Philadelphia, PA | Independence Visitor Center**
⏰ **9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Doors open at 8:30 AM)**
* * *
### ⚙️ Why This Matters
The future of work isn't just digital--it's deeply human. People like Guy Berkebile remind us that America's strength has always come from those willing to roll up their sleeves and build.

Paid subscribers make it all possible--just $8/month if you're down to support](https://substack.com/redirect/d4c4df40-1de0-4ea2-b065-5a207de77828?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):**_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/d4c4df40-1de0-4ea2-b065-5a207de77828?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Politico dropped nearly 2,900 pages of leaked messages this week from national Republican operatives -- not trolls, not 4chan randos, but actual aides, campaign staffers, and elected officials. And the shit in those messages? Predictably disgusting. They called Black people "monkeys" and "the watermelon people." They joked about rape. They fantasized about gas chambers. One guy praised Hitler.
And that's not even the whole of it.
This week, we also learned that a Republican staffer had a literal swastika in the background of his Zoom calls -- hanging inside a sitting GOP congressman's office. Congressman Taylor's response? He claimed he was "just made aware." Oh, you _just_ noticed there's a giant swastika in your office? How the fuck did you -- or no one else on your staff -- see that until now? How long has it been there?
If Republicans don't want to be called Nazis, maybe they should stop hiring people who decorate their workspaces with Nazi paraphernalia. Just a thought.
And I can't wait to hear JD Vance's defense of _that_ one.
Because here's the thing: this isn't just about a few "bad apples" getting caught. It's a culture. What does it say about the environment the GOP has created -- that a staffer felt completely comfortable putting a swastika on display, in a congressional office, on camera?
No, Congressman Taylor may not have approved that himself. But he sure as hell built a culture where it felt acceptable. Just like Trump built it. Just like JD Vance helps preserve it.
If that ever happened in my office, I'd be thinking long and hard about how I contributed to something like that. I'd try to be better. They won't.
And what does JD Vance, the Vice President of the United States and the frontrunner for the GOP nomination in 2028, do when asked about all this?
He shrugs. He deflects. He lies. Says it's "nothing compared" to old texts from Jay Jones -- the Democratic nominee for Attorney General in Virginia -- which, to be clear, were also bad. (See how easy that is? You just say it.)
That's why I'm furious. Not shocked. Not confused. Just pissed. Because instead of condemning the toxicity coming from his own political machine, the second-highest official in the country defended it. Minimized it. Excused it. Spun it into a partisan gotcha.
He called Democrats "pearl clutchers," brushing off Nazi jokes, racial slurs, and rape fantasies by framing these operatives as "kids" instead of what they are: professionals in their 20s, 30s, and, yes, 40s.
How many times have they lectured us about not calling them fascists when they act like fascists? How many times have they lectured us about not calling them Nazis when they refuse to fire people who have Nazi paraphernalia in the background of their conference calls?
I'm done not calling a spade a spade. This is who these people are. The Republican Party has a choice: they can either kick these people out, or they can keep having the Vice President of the United States defend them. And if they choose the latter -- if they keep excusing, minimizing, and defending this filth -- then they're telling us exactly what they are, too.
* * *
_**[Endless Urgency is free to read, but we're hustling to launch our new content studio and pay our new Community Manager a living wage. Paid subscribers make it all possible--just $8/month if you're down to support](https://substack.com/redirect/d4c4df40-1de0-4ea2-b065-5a207de77828?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):**_
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/d4c4df40-1de0-4ea2-b065-5a207de77828?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
That tells you everything you need to know about the moral collapse of this JD Vance -- and the party he and Donald Trump lead. This is the same guy who once compared Trump to Hitler... then pivoted from calling him Hitler to calling him boss. The self-styled "family man" who defends hate and calls it leadership. The guy who lectures Democrats about language but has nothing to say about Stephen Miller calling us domestic terrorists. The same jackass who's spent half his vice presidency on vacation -- and had the Army Corps literally raise a river so his family could go kayaking. The system bends for him while the rest of us tread water.
And none of this is random. It's learned behavior. For nearly a decade, Trump has trained a generation of conservatives to believe cruelty is strength, empathy is weakness, and saying the quiet part out loud makes you "authentic."
These Republican operatives didn't invent this filth. They watched their party leaders -- Vance, Bannon, Miller -- sneer, mock, lie, and win. And they learned: this is how power works.
As a father -- and as someone who still believes character should matter -- I keep asking:
Would you be proud if your kids grew up talking like that?
Would you want your daughter bringing one of these guys home?
Would you hire them?
Because if the answer's yes (and for JD Vance we know it is), that says a hell of a lot more about you than it ever will about them.
Because JD Vance isn't just making bad policy. He's setting a bad example. He's teaching men of all ages that decency is optional -- and cruelty is the point.
And yeah, Jay Jones said something horrible. He apologized. He'll face accountability at the ballot box, and voters will decide. But here's the difference: Jones owned it. Vance weaponized it. He used one man's mistake to excuse a culture of hate inside his own party.
The MAGA crowd has spent years teaching kids that empathy is weakness and hate is branding. They've built an entire movement on rage performance and grievance. And now, those kids are grown. They're campaign managers, congressional aides, "policy guys." And this is what they produce.
Even the Young Republican National Federation condemned the messages. Called them vile. Disgraceful. "Unbecoming of any Republican." They demanded resignations. Even they understood this crossed every damn line.
But not the Vice President. He saw Nazis, slurs, and rape jokes -- and his first instinct was to defend them. That's not leadership. I don't know what is.
So yeah, I'm pissed off. Because I'm raising my son in this country. I'm trying to teach him empathy, honesty, decency -- the stuff that used to be baseline American values -- while the second-highest office in the land is modeling the exact opposite.
I'm trying to teach him that being a man means taking responsibility, not deflecting it. That leadership means protecting people, not demeaning them. That you can fight hard without losing your humanity.
But how do you explain to a kid that the Vice President of the United States looked at a pile of racist, Nazi-loving garbage -- and called outrage over it "pearl clutching"? How do you tell him that's not who we are, when so many adults in power act like it is?
This isn't politics. It's moral decay. And if we don't call it out -- loudly, relentlessly, every damn time -- we let it win.
With urgency,
--Mike

As a father -- and as someone who still believes character should matter -- I keep asking: Would you be proud if your kids grew up talking like that? Would you want your daughter bringing one of these guys home? Would you hire them? Because if the answer's yes (and for JD Vance we know it is), that says a hell of a lot more about you than it ever will about them. Because JD Vance isn't just making bad policy. He's setting a bad example. He's teaching men of all ages that decency is optional -- and cruelty is the point. And yeah, Jay Jones said something horrible. He apologized. He'll face accountability at the ballot box, and voters will decide. But here's the difference: Jones owned it. Vance weaponized it. He used one man's mistake to excuse a culture of hate inside his own party. The MAGA crowd has spent years teaching kids that empathy is weakness and hate is branding. They've built an entire movement on rage performance and grievance. And now, those kids are grown. They're campaign managers, congressional aides, "policy guys." And this is what they produce. Even the Young Republican National Federation condemned the messages. Called them vile. Disgraceful. "Unbecoming of any Republican." They demanded resignations. Even they understood this crossed every damn line. But not the Vice President. He saw Nazis, slurs, and rape jokes -- and his first instinct was to defend them. That's not leadership. I don't know what is. So yeah, I'm pissed off. Because I'm raising my son in this country. I'm trying to teach him empathy, honesty, decency -- the stuff that used to be baseline American values -- while the second-highest office in the land is modeling the exact opposite. I'm trying to teach him that being a man means taking responsibility, not deflecting it. That leadership means protecting people, not demeaning them. That you can fight hard without losing your humanity. But how do you explain to a kid that the Vice President of the United States looked at a pile of racist, Nazi-loving garbage -- and called outrage over it "pearl clutching"? How do you tell him that's not who we are, when so many adults in power act like it is? This isn't politics. It's moral decay. And if we don't call it out -- loudly, relentlessly, every damn time -- we let it win. With urgency, --Mike Mike Nellis is a Democratic strategist and entrepreneur who has raised over $1 billion for Democratic campaigns and causes. body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-oshunfiresidechat?refcode=x_251016_firesidechat_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-oshunfiresidechat?refcode=x_251016_firesidechat_act]
Peter,
I sat down for a fireside chat with Ohun Ashe, an organizer and sister in this work, to share something deeply personal: our story, the pain of the last campaign, why I’m running again, and what’s at stake for St. Louis.
We talked about 2024, the price of challenging power, and what it feels like to carry that weight as a Black woman. We also talked about love — the kind that keeps you standing even when the attacks come hard.
Watch it here: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-oshunfiresidechat?refcode=x_251016_firesidechat_act]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-oshunfiresidechat?refcode=x_251016_firesidechat_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-oshunfiresidechat?refcode=x_251016_firesidechat_act]
I won’t lie to you: the last race hurt. Not just me, but our entire community. We were up against billionaire money, lies, and a political machine that wanted to silence our voices. They didn’t just want me out of Congress; they wanted to crush the movement we’ve built together.
But St. Louis doesn’t break. We rise.
That’s why I’m running again. Because families here are still struggling with rent, groceries, and health care. Because our communities are still hurting from environmental injustice, poverty, and politicians who put corporations before people. Because our rights and freedoms are still under attack.
I refuse to let Trump’s billionaires decide the future of St. Louis.
This campaign is about us. About the single mom wondering how to keep the lights on. About the elder who can’t afford their medication. About our kids who deserve safe neighborhoods and a future full of possibilities.
And if we’re going to win, we have to do it together. That means all of us. Right now.
Will you chip in whatever you can today to power this movement? Every dollar goes straight into the fight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-oshunfiresidechat?refcode=x_251016_firesidechat_act]
DONATE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-oshunfiresidechat?refcode=x_251016_firesidechat_act]
Watch the fireside chat, share it with your people, and let’s remind the world: St. Louis is built for this fight. And so am I. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_cab_email-oshunfiresidechat?refcode=x_251016_firesidechat_act]
In solidarity,
Cori

As a Congresswoman, she has always shown up when it’s hardest: securing disaster relief, lowering insulin costs, and delivering millions for our communities.
Across St. Louis, families are being priced out and pushed out. Cori Bush is fighting back for affordable housing, fair wages, and utilities as a human right. Be part of this people-first movement. Join Team Cori today and sign up to volunteer. [https://www.coribush.org]

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Responding to your questions about the shutdown
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=2677%2E4032634%2EqH3ytk

I asked people last week if you had any
questions about the government shutdown. We got hundreds of responses, and
I’d like to share answers to the most frequently asked questions we
received.

Here we go:

“How can we ask the Republican controlled Congress to come to the
negotiating table and still hold fast to our values?” — Philip from New
York

By continuing to tell our health care stories and make our voices heard.
An overwhelming majority of Americans want Congress to restore health care
funding and ensure premium costs don’t go through the roof. We’ve got to
make clear to Republicans that when Americans get those notices that their
premiums are going up, or that they’re losing their Medicaid coverage,
they’ll know who’s responsible.

Democrats will keep holding the line for health care. What can you do?
Your stories are one of the most effective tools we have to get
Republicans to the negotiating table. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-medicaid25-share/?source=EMZ27Z_ENG_E_20251015_V1S1&t=1006&akid=2677%2E4032634%2EqH3ytk ]If you can, please share your
health care story with me and my team here and I’ll carry it with me as I
fight my heart out to restore funding.

“I've been wondering where the Republican members of Congress have gone?
Feels like they've disappeared. Yes, the immediate question is healthcare;
the larger question is if we still have a functioning government to work
with.” — Nancy from Utah

Nancy, it’s a great question. Despite it being day 15 of the shutdown,
Speaker Johnson has sent House Members home rather than work toward a
solution. And Senate Republicans still refuse to sit down with us to
negotiate reopening the government.

To be frank — and as your question mentions — Donald Trump has been trying
to shut down our government ever since he took office. He has canceled
funding that he doesn’t like, fired federal workers that he doesn’t like,
and dismantled agencies that he doesn’t like. He is even using the
shutdown as an excuse to fire even more workers. And where have
Republicans been? It appears they’ve had their spines removed. That’s not
a functioning government.

This was illegal when Trump did it before the shutdown and it’s illegal
now. I'm going to keep holding the line and fighting for our government to
serve the people. If you’re also not happy with how your Republican
representatives have enabled this, keep calling them at (202) 224-3121 and
let them know. They need to hear from their constituents on this.

“Is my Social Security check in jeopardy because of the shutdown?” —
Robert from Ohio

Good question, Robert. No, during a government shutdown you should be
receiving your Social Security check in the mail as normal. But I have to
say, Donald Trump is literally doing everything he can to make it harder
for people to get their Social Security checks. I’m keeping an eye on this
issue.

“Will Medicare bills be paid during shutdown?” — Ann from Massachusetts

Yes. Medicare is still running, even during a government shutdown. But
it’s a great question because this government shutdown fight is really
about health care costs for Americans all across the country. And thinking
about your Medicare bill is a pretty good way to have some perspective on
this fight.

Imagine if you lost your health care. That could be life shattering for
you and your family. Now that’s the experience of the 15 million Americans
across the country who Trump and Republicans are trying to rip health care
away from. That’s why Democrats are in the fight to restore health care.

“Will furloughed federal workers ever receive the wages they're losing
during the shutdown?” — Lesley from Minnesota

open and what closes during a shutdown. To put it simply, some things that
are deemed essential keep running — the post office delivers mail, Social
Security checks go out, Medicare keeps running.

But a few things don’t happen during a government shutdown, including
federal workers getting their paychecks. They just don’t. And the Trump
White House this week put out an announcement that made it seem like those
workers won’t even get back pay for the time missed.

Make no mistake: workers will be paid. This is nothing more than Trump
fearmongering.

There’s actually a law on the books that says that federal workers will
get back pay after a shutdown. And wait for it— guess who signed that law?
Donald Trump.

So furloughed workers will receive their wages back after the shutdown.
And I’m staying in this fight to make sure Trump follows the law and pays
these workers.

“Many who work in the arts and entertainment industry rely on the ACA and
Medicaid for affordable and comprehensive health insurance. Will lack of
access to affordable care discourage working as a small
business/freelancer or in the arts and entertainment industry as a whole?”
— Angela in New York

Thank you for this question, it’s a good one. Here’s the thing: millions
and millions of people rely on the ACA and Medicaid to cover their health
insurance. And you’re right — lots of small businesses and freelance
workers rely on the Affordable Care Act to pay for their health care
bills.

But one thing I always think about is how many people are on Medicaid or
the ACA and don’t even know it! It’s often called something different in
each state. In Massachusetts it’s called MassHealth. In Oklahoma it’s
called SoonerCare.

So millions of people are covered by these programs.

But it doesn’t stop there. Everyone — I mean everyone — will feel the
impacts of the health care cuts that Republicans put in place. Because
when we take that much money out of the health care industry, you’re
looking at rural hospitals closing, and health care costs across the board
going up, for everyone.

That’s what this fight is all about. And it’s why Democrats won’t give up
on saving health care for millions and millions of Americans.

“How dare Trump offer to send $20 billion to Argentina? That money could
be used to cover medical programs for Americans.” — Maryellen from
California

It’s deeply shocking. For those of you who just read that question and
thought, what the heck is she talking about? Here’s what’s going on. Right
now, the Republicans and Donald Trump are working to make sure that
Argentina gets a $20 billion bailout from American taxpayers.

Why? Because he’s trying to help out one of his Wall Street buddies. You
heard that right. So while Trump is turning his back on tens of millions
of Americans who are saying they cannot afford increases in their health
insurance, he’s throwing $20 billion of your money to Argentina.

And I think that says it all. For Donald Trump and the Republicans, this
isn’t about doing what’s right for Americans. No. If it were, they’d work
with Democrats to lower health care costs and reopen the government.
Instead, these Republicans have held zero negotiations with Democrats.
Zero.

They own this shutdown. They own the consequences. And make no mistake:
Democrats are going to keep pushing through their chaos to lower costs and
save health care for millions of Americans.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

I really appreciate each of you for submitting these questions. And I hope
that these answers were helpful. [ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-shutdown25/?source=EMZ27Z_ENG_E_20251015_V1S1&t=1007&akid=2677%2E4032634%2EqH3ytk ]Please keep submitting your questions
here if you have them.

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth

Everyone — I mean everyone — will feel the impacts of the health care cuts that Republicans put in place. Because when we take that much money out of the health care industry, you’re looking at rural hospitals closing, and health care costs across the board going up, for everyone. That’s what this fight is all about. And it’s why Democrats won’t give up on saving health care for millions and millions of Americans. “How dare Trump offer to send $20 billion to Argentina? That money could be used to cover medical programs for Americans.” — Maryellen from California It’s deeply shocking. For those of you who just read that question and thought, what the heck is she talking about? Here’s what’s going on. Right now, the Republicans and Donald Trump are working to make sure that Argentina gets a $20 billion bailout from American taxpayers. Why? Because he’s trying to help out one of his Wall Street buddies. You heard that right. So while Trump is turning his back on tens of millions of Americans who are saying they cannot afford increases in their health insurance, he’s throwing $20 billion of your money to Argentina. And I think that says it all. For Donald Trump and the Republicans, this isn’t about doing what’s right for Americans. No. If it were, they’d work with Democrats to lower health care costs and reopen the government. Instead, these Republicans have held zero negotiations with Democrats. Zero. They own this shutdown. They own the consequences. And make no mistake: Democrats are going to keep pushing through their chaos to lower costs and save health care for millions of Americans. I really appreciate each of you for submitting these questions. And I hope that these answers were helpful. [ ]Please keep submitting your questions here if you have them. subject: It's not an easy decision to make.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
#

Hey, Peter. It’s Mark Kelly.
I want to talk through a difficult decision I had to make about six years ago.
We were a few years into Donald Trump’s first term, and Mitch McConnell was the Senate Majority Leader. Gabby and I both knew we couldn’t just sit on the sidelines as our country went further and further down the wrong path. We had to do something.
So, together, we decided to launch a campaign for Arizona’s seat in the U.S. Senate. I didn’t know if I could win, or if anyone would support me, and I had no idea if my team would be able to raise the resources we’d need to win.
But one by one, people came on board. $5 here, $10 there. More than a million people donated and volunteered to help me, and in November of 2020, we won that campaign.
Around that same time, Jon Ossoff was making a similar decision. He went on to win one of the closest, toughest, most expensive races in the country down in Georgia. Over the last several years, it’s been an honor to work beside him in the Senate. Jon’s been a constant ally, and I’m proud to call him a friend.
He’s up for reelection next year, he’s in for an incredibly tough fight, and it’s absolutely critical that he wins. To do it, we all need to help.
[**So, I’m humbly asking you: Can you make a donation to help Jon raise the resources it’ll take to win?**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-oct25.ZBiurg&refcode=em251016-1-f&t=1&akid=926%2E5691347%2EQyS0oH)

# [This is what it means to be a Michigander](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=176326695&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTc2MzI2Njk1LCJpYXQiOjE3NjA2MjUxNDIsImV4cCI6MTc2MzIxNzE0MiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.93SFuea_Rs5LqIxjCzwbLoVRYAgVSh9IOQKVpQsxnLY)
### I love what I do and who I do it for
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Oct 16
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..4p_kyPkweQKBskbg-GS7A_SZnyoqvmYDvfTNbwnuhEg?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/this-is-what-it-means-to-be-a-michigander?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Hi team,
Do you remember your first car? I sure do. Mine was a used Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme, and it meant the world to me.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5996b68b-7469-4848-9533-3be83655292d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Growing up in a working-class family in Michigan, I saw firsthand how much pride people took in what they built. My parents ran a small landscaping business, and they worked their butts off - early mornings, late nights, snowstorms, humid summer days. They did whatever it took, not because they were getting rich, but because they're Michiganders. **That 's what we do.**
I always knew I wanted to spend my life fighting for the working families and communities I love here in my home state. **It 's what drove me to help lead President Obama's Auto Rescue Task Force during the Great Recession**. It was important, tough work. There were late nights, high stakes, and some tough moments. But we got it done: I'm proud we helped save more than 200,000 auto jobs in Michigan.
I didn't do it to get a pat on the back or my name in the paper - I did it for the people I grew up with, for the Michigan families I knew were trying to put food on the table and provide a decent life for their kids.
I've taken that same calling to fight for working families in Congress. I fought to bring manufacturing back to Michigan and expand opportunities in advanced technology. I played a leading role in passing legislation to grow our economy and rebuild our infrastructure. I'm taking on Donald Trump's reckless tariff policy, writing legislation to stop his tariffs on groceries and lower costs. And when Donald Trump tried to use the military to silence peaceful protestors? I introduced the Stop Trump's Abuse of Power Act to rein him in.
Now, I'm running for U.S. Senate because I believe Michigan deserves a senator who shows up, listens, and then fights like hell to get things done for regular people, not someone who bows down to Donald Trump and the MAGA megadonors trying to flip Michigan red.
Look, running for Senate isn't a vanity project for me. I don't care about fame or playing politics or photo ops - I care about Michiganders. I've never been a person who sits back when there's work to be done. And right now, there's a whole heck of a lot of work to do.
Costs are skyrocketing, and Trump's tariffs are threatening to raise prices on Michigan-made vehicles. He literally said he _" couldn't care less"_ if auto prices go up.
**Well, I couldn 't care **_**more**_**.**
Because the people feeling the pain of Donald Trump's reckless tariffs are Michiganders.
That's who I'm fighting for.
If you believe in that - in hard work, in honesty, and in standing up for working families - I'd be honored to have your support in my battleground Senate race.
**Will you chip in today and help us keep Michigan blue?**
[ Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/33db25f3-9b49-4332-9dcb-0ed6b0ceb90a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thanks for reading this. Let's stand together.
More soon,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in $5 today?

Mine was a used Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme, and it meant the world to me. | | ---|---|--- Growing up in a working-class family in Michigan, I saw firsthand how much pride people took in what they built. My parents ran a small landscaping business, and they worked their butts off - early mornings, late nights, snowstorms, humid summer days. They did whatever it took, not because they were getting rich, but because they're Michiganders. That 's what we do. I always knew I wanted to spend my life fighting for the working families and communities I love here in my home state. It 's what drove me to help lead President Obama's Auto Rescue Task Force during the Great Recession. It was important, tough work. There were late nights, high stakes, and some tough moments. But we got it done: I'm proud we helped save more than 200,000 auto jobs in Michigan. I didn't do it to get a pat on the back or my name in the paper - I did it for the people I grew up with, for the Michigan families I knew were trying to put food on the table and provide a decent life for their kids. I've taken that same calling to fight for working families in Congress. I fought to bring manufacturing back to Michigan and expand opportunities in advanced technology. I played a leading role in passing legislation to grow our economy and rebuild our infrastructure. I'm taking on Donald Trump's reckless tariff policy, writing legislation to stop his tariffs on groceries and lower costs. And when Donald Trump tried to use the military to silence peaceful protestors? I introduced the Stop Trump's Abuse of Power Act to rein him in. Now, I'm running for U.S. Senate because I believe Michigan deserves a senator who shows up, listens, and then fights like hell to get things done for regular people, not someone who bows down to Donald Trump and the MAGA megadonors trying to flip Michigan red. Look, running for Senate isn't a vanity project for me. I don't care about fame or playing politics or photo ops - I care about Michiganders. I've never been a person who sits back when there's work to be done. And right now, there's a whole heck of a lot of work to do. Costs are skyrocketing, and Trump's tariffs are threatening to raise prices on Michigan-made vehicles. He literally said he " couldn't care less" if auto prices go up. Well, I couldn 't care more. Because the people feeling the pain of Donald Trump's reckless tariffs are Michiganders. That's who I'm fighting for. If you believe in that - in hard work, in honesty, and in standing up for working families - I'd be honored to have your support in my battleground Senate race. Will you chip in today and help us keep Michigan blue? Thanks for reading this. Let's stand together. More soon, Haley A personal note from Haley 👋 I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love. But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican. I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win. If you're with me, will you chip in $5 today? Paid for by Haley Stevens for Michigan.** | | | (C) 2025 Haley for MI 33717 Woodward Ave #539, Birmingham, MI 48009 ? ?

body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Mother Jones: Republican Justices Appear Poised to Destroy What’s Left of the Voting Rights Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101625_2&amount=25]
We'll hand this straight to Mother Jones, Team: " The Supreme Court, with its six-to-three Republican-appointed majority, appears ready to kneecap what remains of the Voting Rights Act’s protections for minority political representation. "
The descriptive language seems harsh, but the objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding.
During this week’s oral argument in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.
Team: We have to spread the word about this case and the consequences of dismantling the Voting Rights Act. Fuel our work with $15 or whatever you can today and help us defend the right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101625_2&amount=15]

At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down districting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
“ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’”
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $15 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101625_2&amount=15]

clean_body: Voter Action Project [] Mother Jones: Republican Justices Appear Poised to Destroy What’s Left of the Voting Rights Act [] We'll hand this straight to Mother Jones, Team: " The Supreme Court, with its six-to-three Republican-appointed majority, appears ready to kneecap what remains of the Voting Rights Act’s protections for minority political representation. " The descriptive language seems harsh, but the objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding. During this week’s oral argument in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering. The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent. Team: We have to spread the word about this case and the consequences of dismantling the Voting Rights Act. Fuel our work with $15 or whatever you can today and help us defend the right to vote >> [] GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [] GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [] Other Amount [] At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down districting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end. “ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’” Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity. We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $15 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [] [] [] [] [] [] Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country. Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities. Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? The need for legal counsel is skyrocketing, as tens of thousands of immigrant families are targeted and torn apart. Access to fair, affordable legal representation is limited, and bail bonds are expensive, but when a loved one is separated and wrongfully detained, _legal support can become a family’s most urgent need._
By scaling up financial support to organizations already working to connect our immigrant neighbors to lawyers, the **Defending Our Neighbors Fund** is helping make sure more people have access to legal representation quickly. We know that access to a lawyer can be the difference between whether a family stays together or is separated indefinitely. The Defending Our Neighbors Fund supports organizations who provide legal representation and other forms of legal assistance, such as paying immigration bonds when possible, and expands capacity for frontline advocates — ensuring no one faces this system alone.
Peter, this is about neighbors helping neighbors, making sure our communities and families stay together.
