Peter, I want to start this email with a shoutout to our friends at the New Jersey Policy Institute (NJPI) for [leading the fight](https://xtz223.keap-link010.com/v2/click/369014fba401e596529d345c1719d423/eJyNkMtOw0AMRf9l1hnyIgJlV1VVFaV0gWCNpombuqSe0YxDCFX-HRdQVyCxtc89fpwVAxniqlWleuePLMtVpDw06BCIl5bYNF_drLhN8zRSPdLr2tvBqfL8a_gKXMr3eZJHiicHgjw9LpZ1tV2_bKptLaQzXmb8y3NXFMXVs3pYVBs1z3-K4YS8ehN3UCX7AS4XtShX8bPvhT8wu1DGMcF4BB9gcrbHZkIKjDww3FjfxVmSFXGaxDvwHZCWtPWt5gNoOoIJej9Qi9Rpu9cBDOngsO_FphtzcgY70qNQo7fCjBICaLVpGjvIS3fYI0_aOiS0FMvKxjmg9uffNUzfi8-fpbuNZA==) to get justice for New Jersey teachers who have been sold out by the state’s largest public sector union – the NJEA. As NJPI’s founder Rosemary Becchi [pointed out](https://xtz223.keap-link010.com/v2/click/16159350a9829ddc59b0cf48422535a0/eJyNkMtOw0AMRf9l1hnyIgJlV1VVFaV0gWCNpombuqSe0YxDCFX-HRcQbEBia597_DgrBjLEVatK9cpvWZarSHlo0CEQLy2xaT66WXGd5mmkeqTntbeDU-X51_A3cCnf5kkRKZ4cCPJwv1jW1Xb9tKm2tZDOeJnxL89NUfx4VneLaqPm-U8xnJBXL-IOqmQ_wOWiFuUqfvS98AdmF8o4JhiP4ANMzvbYTEiBkQeGK-u7OEuyIk6TeAe-A9KStr7VfABNRzBB7wdqkTpt9zqAIR0c9r3YdGNOzmBHehRq9FaYUUIArTZNYwd56Q575Elbh4SWYlnZOAfUfv27hulz8fkdqDWNZg==), “The NJEA is a tax-exempt nonprofit.**That status comes with strict requirements to disclose political spending.** Yet over the last decade, **union officials funneled more than $100 million in members’ dues into a shadowy political apparatus** that seems designed to hide its activity.” We have long talked about how the NJEA has used and abused teachers' dues to fund its political ambitions – which lean only one way despite the fact that the NJEA represents teachers from both sides of the political aisle. Never was that more apparent than when the union funneled more than 40 MILLION into the failed gubernatorial campaign of its President, Sean Spiller. NJPI has filed a complaint with the IRS and requested that the New Jersey Election Law Enforcement Commission (ELEC) investigate the NJEA. Here’s why:
1. **Concealing and misleading:** It appears that the NJEA deliberately set up a separate political organization to funnel and hide massive amounts of teachers' dues for political purposes while never registering this political activity on its federal tax forms as required.
2. **Exceeding the limits:** The NJEA allegedly set up _two_ parallel political entities so it could contribute _double_ the allowable amount to Spiller’s campaign.

Teachers are required to give a portion of their hard-earned (and often insufficient) income to the NJEA. The organization is supposed to use those dollars to represent their interests and advocate for them. Instead, it appears they are lying to the teachers who trust them, hiding how the money is really spent, and lining the pockets of Spiller’s political ambitions rather than serving teachers. That’s not OK. Taxpayers and teachers deserve better. And – as Rosemary Becchi rightly pointed out – the NJEA must play by the same rules everyone else is required to follow. We are hopeful justice will prevail and thankful to our friends at NJPI for boldly doing what needs to be done. Now, one more important thing – and I know this is tough to hear. We need to be utilizing vote by mail in the upcoming gubernatorial election. I know it’s an imperfect system. I don’t fully trust it. Skepticism is certainly warranted. But this is the system we have right now and to relinquish those weeks of early voting to the radical Left is political suicide. We have to play the game before us, and that means participating in the vote by mail system and flooding the zone. If we simply stay home or wait for Election Day, we’re doing exactly what the Left wants and making it that much easier to silence our votes. Problems can happen on Election Day - whether personally or system-wide. If we all wait and vote day-of, the system may not be able to sustain it and sabotage is much easier. President Trump said as much in 2024. “If we swamp them, they can't cheat, it just doesn't work out". New Jersey’s future is on the line. We still need to fight the fight over election integrity and fixing our systems. But that battle won’t be won in the next two months. So I urge you. Make certain that your voice is heard in the gubernatorial election. Let’s turn our state back from the cliff, one step at a time. For New Jersey, Elizabeth Nader

body:

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z70lnv2m3f34dpcph3n0kqp7n4epb2g4evp2cpi0_rp22sh2s8i6eor0cdgm8oj6clh2bs)

| | Dear Friend, On September 10, 2025, Charlie Kirk -- husband, father, and founder of Turning Point USA -- was assassinated while speaking at Utah Valley University. His death was not only a personal tragedy but a deliberate attack on free speech, religious freedom, and the values that bind our Republic together. That's why **Christian Action Network** has drafted the **Charlie Kirk Memorial Resolution** , now under review in Congress. More than 50 Members of Congress have already reached out to me about this effort -- a powerful sign that Washington is listening. It's also a reminder that Christian Action Network -- founded in 1990 and faithfully serving for over 40 years -- has built the kind of credibility and persistence that moves the needle in D.C. If passed, it will direct the Architect of the Capitol to commission and place a statue of Charlie Kirk in the U.S. Capitol Rotunda. The Rotunda is where America honors her greatest heroes -- presidents, generals, missionaries, and defenders of liberty. A statue of Charlie Kirk there would send a permanent message: violence will never silence truth. And Charlie not only _DESERVES_ to be there...he _EARNED THE RIGHT_ to be there! _But Congress will only act if it feels the pressure of the American people ... Your voice matters..._ 👉 [**[SIGN THE PETITION NOW]**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z32gajp2f8rd662u01as0itml0ppgc4haepe62jo_rp22sh2s8i6eor0cdgm8oj6clh2bs) to urge Congress to pass the Charlie Kirk Memorial Resolution. Every name added strengthens this campaign and tells Members of Congress that America has not forgotten Charlie's courage. _And after you sign_ , please prayerfully consider making a gift to support this effort. Your contribution will help us keep the pressure on Congress and prepare the next step: securing Charlie's memory with statues and memorials on federal lands across the nation 👉 **[[SUPPORT THIS EFFORT]>>](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z88d5iascl97vc9ojv3cmvvuoa69fb2mn71vuuh8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0cdgm8oj6clh2bs)**[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zfhsiqi843kfn853am63nutcdpa6lch83itphlo8_rp22sh2s8i6eor0cdgm8oj6clh2bs)[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z06bqsjhc4b3p19rundshecrvdqr1bfc6gnqe0ug_rp22sh2s8i6eor0cdgm8oj6clh2bs) Charlie gave his life standing for faith, freedom, and truth. If you would like to pause emails from Team Warner until the federal government reopens,[_**please let us know by completing this form**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117396286/576339823/222818858?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM3_251016_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWFhMjM2OS1hMmFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1q84bpMxiK3hVkch0xadMgnTLZ5hHb4uEiYzrMJz2Xk=&emci=57a4a815-e4a9-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&emdi=45aa2369-a2aa-f011-8e61-6045bded8ba4&ceid=4568237)._ Derek,

You’ve probably seen my name in your inbox quite a bit lately – and I know I’ve asked for your support just as often.

That’s why today, I want to take a moment to reintroduce myself, so you can know more about the senator behind the computer [_**asking for contributions to his reelection campaign.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117396288/576339825/1424898392?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM3_251016_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWFhMjM2OS1hMmFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1q84bpMxiK3hVkch0xadMgnTLZ5hHb4uEiYzrMJz2Xk=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117396291/576339828/1424898392?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM3_251016_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWFhMjM2OS1hMmFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1q84bpMxiK3hVkch0xadMgnTLZ5hHb4uEiYzrMJz2Xk=) I was the very first in my family to graduate college – and I only did so thanks to student loans and a few side jobs. To this day, I’m still incredibly grateful to the public schools that I attended that put me on this path. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117396293/576339830/1424898392?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM3_251016_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWFhMjM2OS1hMmFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1q84bpMxiK3hVkch0xadMgnTLZ5hHb4uEiYzrMJz2Xk=) This path hasn’t always been easy.

After college, I decided to pursue business ... where my first two ventures _failed_. But the remarkable thing about this country is I got a third try. Thankfully, the third one stuck. I’m proud to have founded what became one of Virginia’s leading tech companies.

**What got me into politics in the first place was the notion that every American ought to have the same fair shot that I had.**

So, I entered the world of public service. I ran for governor of Virginia – and won. Here’s me and my good friend Tim Kaine (now my fellow Virginia senator) when he was running for lieutenant governor alongside my campaign for governor. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117396296/576339832/1424898392?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM3_251016_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWFhMjM2OS1hMmFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1q84bpMxiK3hVkch0xadMgnTLZ5hHb4uEiYzrMJz2Xk=) We left office with Virginia ranked the best state for business, the best managed state, _and_ the best state to get a public education. But I knew that this was not the end of our work to give every Virginian a fair shot at success.

So I ran for the United States Senate, and won. Since then, I helped spearhead the largest infrastructure and public lands investments in half a century, expanded Virginia’s domestic manufacturing, and fought (and continue to fight) to lower health care costs. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117396301/576339835/1424898392?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM3_251016_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWFhMjM2OS1hMmFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1q84bpMxiK3hVkch0xadMgnTLZ5hHb4uEiYzrMJz2Xk=) | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117396303/576339841/1424898392?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM3_251016_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWFhMjM2OS1hMmFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1q84bpMxiK3hVkch0xadMgnTLZ5hHb4uEiYzrMJz2Xk=) | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117396306/576339843/1424898392?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_MM3_251016_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NWFhMjM2OS1hMmFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1q84bpMxiK3hVkch0xadMgnTLZ5hHb4uEiYzrMJz2Xk=)
---|---|---
**Virginia is the place I’ve called home. It’s where I built my business and raised my family – and it’s where I want every person to have the same fair shot that I did.**

But the reality is, right now in Washington, we’ve got a president who is more focused on making himself and his family richer than getting things done for the Americans who elected him to office.

And – even more appalling to me – we’ve seen Republicans in Congress bend the knee to his every demand, no matter the cost to their constituents.

The path to taking back our country starts right here in the Commonwealth, where in just 19 days, we’ll have the chance to flip the governor’s office from red to blue. Then next year, we’ll have the chance to hand Republicans _another_ sweeping defeat, when this Senate seat – and with it, Senate control – is on the ballot.

It’s all on the line – right here in Virginia.

clean_body: I’m running for the Senate against a politician who, while our streets burned, pushed lawsuits against law enforcement officials | Peter, My name is Adam Schwarze, and I’m a former Navy SEAL, Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan running for U.S. Senate against Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor—a politician even more radical than her boss. I’m requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota. I hold a Master’s from Harvard, a Master’s Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations. I’m starting this race with absolutely nothing , but because of the enormity of the race's outcome, I figured there is no harm in asking for your help. At the end of the day, my request of you will end in one of two ways: 1.) . 2.) you read this email without contributing, but you at least now know who I am. I’m not a career politician. I’m a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey and answered our nation’s call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war. Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, defunded our police , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe. This isn’t the Minnesota I grew up in—or the one any Minnesotan deserves. If you are reading this email right now and you don’t live in Minnesota, then I’m sure you’ll agree with me that every American must be represented by individuals in Congress who want to build a better version of the America we live in today—individuals of integrity. That’s not who my opponent is. We have an incredible opportunity to elect a Republican to the U.S. Senate next year - something voters in this state haven’t done since they re-elected former Senator Norm Coleman in 2002. As a Republican, I know the odds are tough in a state that hasn’t voted red in a presidential election since 1976. But as a former Navy SEAL, I thrive in tough fights. I’ve faced worse odds overseas and am ready to bring that same grit to Washington. Here’s what I stand for: Restoring law and order by supporting our police and cracking down on crime. Cutting taxes and regulations to ease the burden on retirees and small businesses. Securing our borders to protect our communities and sovereignty. Defending our Second Amendment rights and traditional values. Stopping the radical left’s agenda that’s eroding the America we love. You don’t know me, but you know what men like me stand for and our reputation. So, . This race won’t be easy. The Democrats have deep pockets, and the radical left will stop at nothing to keep this seat. I’m running to serve you, to protect our way of life, and to ensure Minnesota remains a place where faith, family, and freedom thrive. I hope you’ll invest in me right now – any amount will help. With gratitude, Adam Schwarze Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate - Minnesota FOLLOW ADAM ON SOCIAL MEDIA** | | Paid for by Schwarze for Senate

Last month, President Trump hosted members of his cabinet and a handful of conservative influencers to warn that "Antifa" was destroying cities like Portland, Oregon -- chaos, death, and destruction that only the U.S. military could supposedly stop. Let's take a look at some of that chaos now:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/24c98fc1-e8c9-4509-acfe-0fb47d75021e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thanks for reading By the Ballot! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYnl0aGViYWxsb3QuY29tL2FjY291bnQiLCJwIjoxNzYyMTg4NTEsInMiOjUxNTY1NjYsImYiOnRydWUsInUiOjkwNTAxMTkyLCJpYXQiOjE3NjA2MzAyMzAsImV4cCI6MjA3NjIwNjIzMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTAiLCJzdWIiOiJsaW5rLXJlZGlyZWN0In0.rxPnJNI-lWTbCZ_1abNv7Y9anMimROFA-BoQZOnZHoY?)
What Trump and his MAGA crowd are banking on is that no one will actually pay attention to the work of journalists and activists who are showing this farce for what it is: an overexaggerated distraction at best and an excuse to use the military on US citizens at worst.
For the past several weeks, GOP Leaders and [Speaker Mike Johnson have called](https://substack.com/redirect/21b474b7-b73f-4244-94d1-06ad94ba77fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the "No Kings" rallies planned by Indivisible for October 18 "Hate America rallies" that would be filled with "pro-Hamas, Antifa people." I don't know what kind of "Antifa" Johnson imagines, but it's hard to picture suburban moms and retirees carrying signs for Medicare and democracy as masked anarchists.
Like so much of the right's co-opted vocabulary, "Antifa" has become a blanket term for anyone demonstrating against Republican authoritarianism -- from journalists documenting ICE "snatch and grabs" to activists defending neighbors from unlawful arrests.
It's a pattern we've seen before:
* They claim "rampant crime" from undocumented immigrants, so they paint every migrant as MS-13.
* They talk about "lazy" people gaming Medicaid -- so they slash healthcare for millions.
* They cherry-pick one accused individual who identifies as a trans woman to brand all trans women as sexual predators.

Each straw man is a setup for cruelty -- a caricature built to justify punishment.
So who are these masked men who are seemingly terrorizing the very hearts and minds of the MAGA faithful? Why do their antics cause these Mar-a-Lago patrons to clutch their pearls with their very lives? And what are Trump and his crew actually up to with stunts like these roundtables?
## What is Antifa?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cd3abce8-5963-4664-9950-35b90e25fa22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Let's start with the basics. You've heard it spouted many times out of the mouth of prominent Republicans and conservative talking heads: their favorite gang of masked boogeymen clad in black bloc that somehow orchestrated the mass chaos during the Black Lives Matter Rallies, the January 6th insurrection, and the assassination of Charlie Kirk: Antifa. But what is Antifa?
Despite what the geniuses in the GOP claim, Antifa isn't an organization. It doesn't have a leader, a headquarters, or a central command. [Even Trump's own former FBI Director Christopher Wray admitted:](https://substack.com/redirect/c56bee5e-56af-4ffd-932c-0aecd87d6974?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) it's not a group or organization -- it's a movement, an ideology.
[Antifa](https://substack.com/redirect/a1c0939f-4567-4e83-9a18-dad4099945a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is short for antifaschistisch -- German for "anti-fascist" -- and traces its lineage to Antifaschistische Aktion, a grassroots coalition founded in 1932 by members of the Communist Party of Germany to resist Hitler's rise to power. That movement itself was inspired by the anti-Fascisti groups that emerged in Italy in the mid-1920s, formed by socialists, anarchists, and labor organizers in opposition to Mussolini's Partito Nazionale Fascista.
So yes -- the people who literally fought Nazis and Mussolini's blackshirts are somehow the "bad guys" now.
In the U.S., antifa is a decentralized network of activists with anti-authoritarian, anti-fascist, and anti-racist beliefs. Many who organize against ICE, police brutality, or far-right extremism fall under its umbrella -- often labeled "Antifa" by the right whether or not they identify that way.
[Their tactics range ](https://substack.com/redirect/6f460fae-7047-435b-a2dc-8d99d0e500d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)from nonviolent direct action -- protests, community organizing, mutual aid -- to a small fringe that engages in digital activism, doxing, or property damage. The throughline: confronting fascism head-on. The modern American Antifa movement traces its roots to Anti-Racist Action in the 1980s, but it was Trump's election in 2016 that gave it new prominence -- especially after Charlottesville in 2017 and during the 2020 protests after George Floyd's murder.
Contrary to right-wing punditry and GOP talking points, [most anti-fascist](https://substack.com/redirect/0e8c8ac6-be98-49ef-9c30-38552806b97c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) groups plan for de-escalation, not violence. Their work looks a lot more like handing out water and legal hotlines than breaking windows. So what were Trump and his cabinet really talking about on October 8?
## Round Table Meeting for Very Smart and Very Serious People
On Wednesday, October 8th, Donald Trump convened a "roundtable" of cabinet officials -- including DHS Secretary Kristi Noem, Attorney General Pam Bondi, and FBI Director Kash Patel -- alongside right-wing influ-_I 'm sorry_, "independent journalists" like Andy Ngo, Nick Sortor, Katie Daviscourt, and others. The entire spectacle was theater -- part disinformation session, part loyalty test.
"They are just as sophisticated as MS-13, as TDA [Tren de Aragua], as ISIS, as Hezbollah, as Hamas," [said Secretary Kristi Noem,](https://substack.com/redirect/46b95f29-0020-4774-8e22-cd2915e33add?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about a decentralized movement that literally has no leadership structure. "They have an agenda to destroy us, just like the other terrorists we've dealt with for many, many years."
Noem intentionally cited organizations formally designated as terrorist entities to fit the GOP's ongoing narrative -- echoing the president's [Executive Order](https://substack.com/redirect/33cc0774-4cd2-4b3d-b57c-66cdd6ccf330?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) aimed at labeling Antifa a "domestic terrorist organization," **[despite the fact that no such legal mechanism exists in U.S. law](https://substack.com/redirect/e9fe3736-3ab3-418c-8169-897b6b20a2bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[.](https://substack.com/redirect/e9fe3736-3ab3-418c-8169-897b6b20a2bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[She even claimed they had ](https://substack.com/redirect/e4bc92e1-2e6e-4e48-abfc-305dce9903ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"the girlfriend of one of the founders of Antifa" in custody in Portland and were "trying to prosecute her." Unless that woman is a 100-year-old Italian anti-fascist, Noem was either lying or making someone a patsy to score political points.
President Trump and his top lieutenants vowed to use "the full weight of the federal government" to combat Antifa with the same force used against drug cartels and foreign terrorists. At one point, Attorney General Pam Bondi declared
> "Fighting crime is more than just getting the bad guy off the streets. It's breaking down the organization brick by brick, just like we did with cartels. We're going to take the same approach, President Trump, with Antifa -- destroy the entire organization, from top to bottom. We're going to take them apart."
That statement was followed by [Patel pledging ](https://substack.com/redirect/4ea26b7f-e3ae-4f86-b49b-97d198981af5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)that the FBI "will not rest until we find every single seed money, donor organization, and funding mechanism that we have," adding that he was working with Treasury Secretary Bessent to track "those who fund these violent activities."
If you've been paying attention, this fits neatly into the Trump administration's new playbook: use "domestic terrorism" as a pretext to target political opponents financially, legally, and organizationally. The administration has already used airstrikes against alleged cartel [boats off the Venezuelan coast ](https://substack.com/redirect/0e5d7a3c-1037-4751-a71c-c564e37d1cce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)-- now they're floating the same approach toward protesters and activists at home.
The October 8th meeting wasn't about Antifa at all. It was about building a legal and rhetorical foundation to go after left-leaning donors and organizations under the guise of counter-terrorism. It was the latest attempt to turn fear into justification for repression -- and the press conference that followed was the first draft of their propaganda campaign.
## Grasping for those Straw Men
Trump came in hot to his second term with one goal in mind: dismantling Democratic and leftist-aligned organizations, primarily through financial warfare. His allies in Congress have already floated investigations into ActBlue and hinted at audits of liberal-leaning nonprofits. It's part of a broader campaign to criminalize opposition under the guise of "national security."
Following the assassination of Charlie Kirk and the alleged link to "the Left," right-wing agitator Laura Loomer tweeted, "The best way President Trump can reinforce Charlie's legacy is by cracking down on the Left with the full force of the government."
So how does this connect to their obsession with blaming everything on "Antifa"?
It's the same playbook we saw two decades ago: Dick Cheney and Donald Rumsfeld needed a reason to invade Iraq, so they created one -- "weapons of mass destruction." Trump and his administration are now searching for their own WMD moment, something they can point to as justification for targeting left-wing organizations and donors powering the movement against them.
It's easy to create a monster when the public doesn't have access to the whole picture -- especially when that confusion is intentional. Trump and his allies have built up "Antifa" into a shadowy, omnipresent super-threat by accusing it of everything from "burning down Seattle and Minneapolis" after George Floyd's murder, to instigating the January 6th attack, to orchestrating assassination attempts on Trump himself. They've even tried to link the killers of Minnesota Speaker Melissa Hortman and Charlie Kirk to supposed "Antifa sympathies."
The point isn't truth -- it's fear. When the president of the United States and his cabinet label a non-existent organization as the root of domestic terrorism, it opens the door to extraordinary measures: surveillance, prosecution, and political purges.
Many observers have noted that the October 8th "roundtable" focused more on laying the groundwork for future policies than on the policies themselves. Trump and his team are already deploying the National Guard in cities like Los Angeles, D.C., Portland, and Chicago -- claiming they're protecting ICE agents from "Antifa terrorists," even though the people confronting those agents have been mainly journalists, neighbors, and elected officials protecting their constituents from unlawful detentions.
When demonstrators object to those overreaches, the administration calls them "paid agitators." Because in Trump's worldview, no rational person could oppose authoritarianism -- there must always be a villain, a puppet master, a George Soros behind the curtain.
And sure enough, [Trump took to Truth Social in August](https://substack.com/redirect/9b880fa1-1445-49a2-bd7a-7f77e05a51c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to demand:[,](https://substack.com/redirect/9b880fa1-1445-49a2-bd7a-7f77e05a51c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "George Soros, and his wonderful Radical Left son, should be charged with RICO because of their support of Violent Protests, and much more, all throughout the United States of America."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/184be0f8-9b79-4ff1-87ab-d38598199892?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It's part of a deliberate strategy to conflate Democrats, leftist movements, and even fundamental protest rights with terrorism -- a way to fold the entire opposition into one imagined enemy. It's lazy, dangerous, and effective. Because if they can convince the public that "Antifa" and "the Left" are interchangeable, then suddenly every donation, every protest, and every critical voice becomes "aiding and abetting domestic terror."
That's not law enforcement. That's fascism with paperwork.
## The Path of the Money
Following the October roundtable, [Reuters published a damning report exposing ](https://substack.com/redirect/8d5a2e3b-2136-45e2-815a-ca9f8e7807eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)what many had already suspected: the Trump administration has developed an explicit plan to use the full force of the federal government against left-wing organizations -- all under the guise of "countering domestic terrorism."
According to the report, Trump's senior advisor Stephen Miller is helping to lead the effort, which involves deploying America's counterterrorism apparatus -- the FBI, Department of Homeland Security, Department of Justice, IRS, and Treasury Department -- to investigate and potentially dismantle groups accused of funding or organizing "political violence."
Two weeks after the assassination of Charlie Kirk, Trump issued National Security Presidential Memorandum 7 (NSPM-7), or the Countering Domestic Terrorism and Organized Political Violence Directive. The order directs the National Joint Terrorism Task Force, created by the Patriot Act in 2002 after 9/11, to focus on "domestic terrorists whose ideologies include anti-Americanism, anti-capitalism, and anti-Christianity."
While a White House official claimed the directive "remains focused on violence and illegal activity," Trump's own rhetoric tells a different story. When asked who these "domestic terrorists" were, he didn't hesitate: George Soros and Reid Hoffman, the co-founder of LinkedIn and a prominent Democratic donor who famously bailed out NGP VAN last year.
In almost direct contradiction to the official line, the White House later named nine liberal groups and donors it claimed "helped finance or plan protests where violent incidents occurred." The list included ActBlue, Indivisible, the Coalition for Humane Immigrant Rights (CHIRLA), and the Open Society Foundations.
Administration insiders say the task force is exploring several tools to defund or shut down these groups, including:
* IRS investigations to strip nonprofits of their tax-exempt status,
* Criminal probes by the DOJ and FBI,
* Surveillance programs under DHS authority,
* And the use of RICO statutes and anti-terror laws to target donor networks and financial partners."

The logic is chillingly simple: paint left-leaning donors as "terror financiers," then use national security powers to neutralize them. It's not just suppression -- it's financial warfare.
Presidential historian Timothy Naftali told Reuters, "Trump and Nixon share the same desire to punish political enemies and silence critics, but the difference is that today's Congress and cabinet are enabling him to go further. That's why this moment is far more dangerous for the rule of law than the 1970s ever were."
Trump has made no effort to hide his vindictive streak. He's repeatedly said that "disloyal" or "anti-American" entities will "face the consequences." And now, through NSPM-7, he's found a legal framework to carry out those threats -- one that fuses political persecution with national security.
This is the authoritarian dream realized: punish your enemies, bankrupt your critics, and use the law itself as the weapon.
And when you follow the money, you find the real story -- not about "Antifa" or "terrorism," but about power, punishment, and control.
### **" If they are against the anti-fascists, what does that make them?"**
President Trump and his allies will stop at nothing to take down anyone who dares oppose their inhumane acts or the authoritarian takeover of our government. His appetite for punishment is endless, and his methods increasingly lawless.
While Democrats and the Left find themselves navigating this treacherous ground, we must remember that the Constitution still grants us the right to speak, to organize, and to resist. We must educate ourselves and one another -- legally and civically -- to defend those rights like [this lawyer who joined protestors demonstrating against law enforcement in Chicago](https://substack.com/redirect/b30c87db-7179-4b11-84e9-12e5e19869bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), because this administration is betting that fear will keep us quiet.
We have already seen what comes next when that fear takes hold: peaceful protestors snatched off the streets, journalists assaulted by federal agents, and activists branded as terrorists for defending their neighbors. And now, Trump is preparing to use the full weight of the state -- the FBI, IRS, DHS, and DOJ -- to bankrupt and imprison his political enemies.
As horrifying as that is, it's also clarifying. It reminds us that this fight has always been about more than politics. It's about power -- who wields it, and who suffers under it.
So, yes, it's scary as hell. But we've been here before. We have inherited the legacy of the anti-fascists who stood against the brownshirts of the 1930s, the civil rights organizers who faced down segregationists, and the activists who risked everything to make America live up to its promises.
And while it feels dark right now, we are not powerless. We still have each other.
So find your team. Take care of each other. And keep fighting the good fight.

How the Trump Administration is Building a Case Against the Left Using False Pretenses | | | Oct 16 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Last month, President Trump hosted members of his cabinet and a handful of conservative influencers to warn that "Antifa" was destroying cities like Portland, Oregon -- chaos, death, and destruction that only the U.S. military could supposedly stop. Let's take a look at some of that chaos now: Thanks for reading By the Ballot! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. ? What Trump and his MAGA crowd are banking on is that no one will actually pay attention to the work of journalists and activists who are showing this farce for what it is: an overexaggerated distraction at best and an excuse to use the military on US citizens at worst. For the past several weeks, GOP Leaders and the "No Kings" rallies planned by Indivisible for October 18 "Hate America rallies" that would be filled with "pro-Hamas, Antifa people." I don't know what kind of "Antifa" Johnson imagines, but it's hard to picture suburban moms and retirees carrying signs for Medicare and democracy as masked anarchists. Like so much of the right's co-opted vocabulary, "Antifa" has become a blanket term for anyone demonstrating against Republican authoritarianism -- from journalists documenting ICE "snatch and grabs" to activists defending neighbors from unlawful arrests. It's a pattern we've seen before: They claim "rampant crime" from undocumented immigrants, so they paint every migrant as MS-13. They talk about "lazy" people gaming Medicaid -- so they slash healthcare for millions. They cherry-pick one accused individual who identifies as a trans woman to brand all trans women as sexual predators. Each straw man is a setup for cruelty -- a caricature built to justify punishment. So who are these masked men who are seemingly terrorizing the very hearts and minds of the MAGA faithful? Why do their antics cause these Mar-a-Lago patrons to clutch their pearls with their very lives? And what are Trump and his crew actually up to with stunts like these roundtables? What is Antifa? | | ---|---|--- Let's start with the basics. You've heard it spouted many times out of the mouth of prominent Republicans and conservative talking heads: their favorite gang of masked boogeymen clad in black bloc that somehow orchestrated the mass chaos during the Black Lives Matter Rallies, the January 6th insurrection, and the assassination of Charlie Kirk: Antifa. But what is Antifa? Despite what the geniuses in the GOP claim, Antifa isn't an organization. It doesn't have a leader, a headquarters, or a central command. it's not a group or organization -- it's a movement, an ideology. is short for antifaschistisch -- German for "anti-fascist" -- and traces its lineage to Antifaschistische Aktion, a grassroots coalition founded in 1932 by members of the Communist Party of Germany to resist Hitler's rise to power. That movement itself was inspired by the anti-Fascisti groups that emerged in Italy in the mid-1920s, formed by socialists, anarchists, and labor organizers in opposition to Mussolini's Partito Nazionale Fascista. So yes -- the people who literally fought Nazis and Mussolini's blackshirts are somehow the "bad guys" now. In the U.S., antifa is a decentralized network of activists with anti-authoritarian, anti-fascist, and anti-racist beliefs. Many who organize against ICE, police brutality, or far-right extremism fall under its umbrella -- often labeled "Antifa" by the right whether or not they identify that way. nonviolent direct action -- protests, community organizing, mutual aid -- to a small fringe that engages in digital activism, doxing, or property damage. The throughline: confronting fascism head-on. The modern American Antifa movement traces its roots to Anti-Racist Action in the 1980s, but it was Trump's election in 2016 that gave it new prominence -- especially after Charlottesville in 2017 and during the 2020 protests after George Floyd's murder. Contrary to right-wing punditry and GOP talking points, groups plan for de-escalation, not violence. Their work looks a lot more like handing out water and legal hotlines than breaking windows. So what were Trump and his cabinet really talking about on October 8? Round Table Meeting for Very Smart and Very Serious People On Wednesday, October 8th, Donald Trump convened a "roundtable" of cabinet officials -- including DHS Secretary Kristi Noem, Attorney General Pam Bondi, and FBI Director Kash Patel -- alongside right-wing influ-I 'm sorry, "independent journalists" like Andy Ngo, Nick Sortor, Katie Daviscourt, and others. The entire spectacle was theater -- part disinformation session, part loyalty test. "They are just as sophisticated as MS-13, as TDA [Tren de Aragua], as ISIS, as Hezbollah, as Hamas," about a decentralized movement that literally has no leadership structure. "They have an agenda to destroy us, just like the other terrorists we've dealt with for many, many years." Noem intentionally cited organizations formally designated as terrorist entities to fit the GOP's ongoing narrative -- echoing the president's aimed at labeling Antifa a "domestic terrorist organization," "the girlfriend of one of the founders of Antifa" in custody in Portland and were "trying to prosecute her." Unless that woman is a 100-year-old Italian anti-fascist, Noem was either lying or making someone a patsy to score political points. President Trump and his top lieutenants vowed to use "the full weight of the federal government" to combat Antifa with the same force used against drug cartels and foreign terrorists. At one point, Attorney General Pam Bondi declared "Fighting crime is more than just getting the bad guy off the streets. It's breaking down the organization brick by brick, just like we did with cartels. We're going to take the same approach, President Trump, with Antifa -- destroy the entire organization, from top to bottom. We're going to take them apart." That statement was followed by the FBI "will not rest until we find every single seed money, donor organization, and funding mechanism that we have," adding that he was working with Treasury Secretary Bessent to track "those who fund these violent activities." If you've been paying attention, this fits neatly into the Trump administration's new playbook: use "domestic terrorism" as a pretext to target political opponents financially, legally, and organizationally. The administration has already used airstrikes against alleged cartel -- now they're floating the same approach toward protesters and activists at home. The October 8th meeting wasn't about Antifa at all. It was about building a legal and rhetorical foundation to go after left-leaning donors and organizations under the guise of counter-terrorism. It was the latest attempt to turn fear into justification for repression -- and the press conference that followed was the first draft of their propaganda campaign. Grasping for those Straw Men Trump came in hot to his second term with one goal in mind: dismantling Democratic and leftist-aligned organizations, primarily through financial warfare. His allies in Congress have already floated investigations into ActBlue and hinted at audits of liberal-leaning nonprofits. It's part of a broader campaign to criminalize opposition under the guise of "national security." Following the assassination of Charlie Kirk and the alleged link to "the Left," right-wing agitator Laura Loomer tweeted, "The best way President Trump can reinforce Charlie's legacy is by cracking down on the Left with the full force of the government." So how does this connect to their obsession with blaming everything on "Antifa"? It's the same playbook we saw two decades ago: Dick Cheney and Donald Rumsfeld needed a reason to invade Iraq, so they created one -- "weapons of mass destruction." Trump and his administration are now searching for their own WMD moment, something they can point to as justification for targeting left-wing organizations and donors powering the movement against them. It's easy to create a monster when the public doesn't have access to the whole picture -- especially when that confusion is intentional. Trump and his allies have built up "Antifa" into a shadowy, omnipresent super-threat by accusing it of everything from "burning down Seattle and Minneapolis" after George Floyd's murder, to instigating the January 6th attack, to orchestrating assassination attempts on Trump himself. They've even tried to link the killers of Minnesota Speaker Melissa Hortman and Charlie Kirk to supposed "Antifa sympathies." The point isn't truth -- it's fear. When the president of the United States and his cabinet label a non-existent organization as the root of domestic terrorism, it opens the door to extraordinary measures: surveillance, prosecution, and political purges. Many observers have noted that the October 8th "roundtable" focused more on laying the groundwork for future policies than on the policies themselves. Trump and his team are already deploying the National Guard in cities like Los Angeles, D.C., Portland, and Chicago -- claiming they're protecting ICE agents from "Antifa terrorists," even though the people confronting those agents have been mainly journalists, neighbors, and elected officials protecting their constituents from unlawful detentions. When demonstrators object to those overreaches, the administration calls them "paid agitators." Because in Trump's worldview, no rational person could oppose authoritarianism -- there must always be a villain, a puppet master, a George Soros behind the curtain. And sure enough, to demand: "George Soros, and his wonderful Radical Left son, should be charged with RICO because of their support of Violent Protests, and much more, all throughout the United States of America." | | ---|---|--- It's part of a deliberate strategy to conflate Democrats, leftist movements, and even fundamental protest rights with terrorism -- a way to fold the entire opposition into one imagined enemy. It's lazy, dangerous, and effective. Because if they can convince the public that "Antifa" and "the Left" are interchangeable, then suddenly every donation, every protest, and every critical voice becomes "aiding and abetting domestic terror." That's not law enforcement. That's fascism with paperwork. The Path of the Money Following the October roundtable, many had already suspected: the Trump administration has developed an explicit plan to use the full force of the federal government against left-wing organizations -- all under the guise of "countering domestic terrorism." According to the report, Trump's senior advisor Stephen Miller is helping to lead the effort, which involves deploying America's counterterrorism apparatus -- the FBI, Department of Homeland Security, Department of Justice, IRS, and Treasury Department -- to investigate and potentially dismantle groups accused of funding or organizing "political violence." Two weeks after the assassination of Charlie Kirk, Trump issued National Security Presidential Memorandum 7 (NSPM-7), or the Countering Domestic Terrorism and Organized Political Violence Directive. The order directs the National Joint Terrorism Task Force, created by the Patriot Act in 2002 after 9/11, to focus on "domestic terrorists whose ideologies include anti-Americanism, anti-capitalism, and anti-Christianity." While a White House official claimed the directive "remains focused on violence and illegal activity," Trump's own rhetoric tells a different story. When asked who these "domestic terrorists" were, he didn't hesitate: George Soros and Reid Hoffman, the co-founder of LinkedIn and a prominent Democratic donor who famously bailed out NGP VAN last year. In almost direct contradiction to the official line, the White House later named nine liberal groups and donors it claimed "helped finance or plan protests where violent incidents occurred." The list included ActBlue, Indivisible, the Coalition for Humane Immigrant Rights (CHIRLA), and the Open Society Foundations. Administration insiders say the task force is exploring several tools to defund or shut down these groups, including: IRS investigations to strip nonprofits of their tax-exempt status, Criminal probes by the DOJ and FBI, Surveillance programs under DHS authority, And the use of RICO statutes and anti-terror laws to target donor networks and financial partners." The logic is chillingly simple: paint left-leaning donors as "terror financiers," then use national security powers to neutralize them. It's not just suppression -- it's financial warfare. Presidential historian Timothy Naftali told Reuters, "Trump and Nixon share the same desire to punish political enemies and silence critics, but the difference is that today's Congress and cabinet are enabling him to go further. That's why this moment is far more dangerous for the rule of law than the 1970s ever were." Trump has made no effort to hide his vindictive streak. He's repeatedly said that "disloyal" or "anti-American" entities will "face the consequences." And now, through NSPM-7, he's found a legal framework to carry out those threats -- one that fuses political persecution with national security. This is the authoritarian dream realized: punish your enemies, bankrupt your critics, and use the law itself as the weapon. And when you follow the money, you find the real story -- not about "Antifa" or "terrorism," but about power, punishment, and control. " If they are against the anti-fascists, what does that make them?" President Trump and his allies will stop at nothing to take down anyone who dares oppose their inhumane acts or the authoritarian takeover of our government. His appetite for punishment is endless, and his methods increasingly lawless. While Democrats and the Left find themselves navigating this treacherous ground, we must remember that the Constitution still grants us the right to speak, to organize, and to resist. We must educate ourselves and one another -- legally and civically -- to defend those rights like , because this administration is betting that fear will keep us quiet. We have already seen what comes next when that fear takes hold: peaceful protestors snatched off the streets, journalists assaulted by federal agents, and activists branded as terrorists for defending their neighbors. And now, Trump is preparing to use the full weight of the state -- the FBI, IRS, DHS, and DOJ -- to bankrupt and imprison his political enemies. As horrifying as that is, it's also clarifying. It reminds us that this fight has always been about more than politics. It's about power -- who wields it, and who suffers under it. So, yes, it's scary as hell. But we've been here before. We have inherited the legacy of the anti-fascists who stood against the brownshirts of the 1930s, the civil rights organizers who faced down segregationists, and the activists who risked everything to make America live up to its promises. And while it feels dark right now, we are not powerless. We still have each other. So find your team. Take care of each other. And keep fighting the good fight. Here's how I plan to keep Colorado's kids safe online.
| | |
---
Team,
Across Colorado, I hear the same concerns from parents, teachers, mental health professionals, and kids themselves: **Kids are facing a mental health crisis, and social media and AI are only making it worse.**
As a dad to three incredible daughters who grew up in the digital era, I know how difficult it is for parents to protect their kids online.
That's why I just unveiled my plan to keep Colorado's kids safe online.

**_[If you're short on time and this is as big a priority to you as it is for my campaign, then before I dig in, I hope you'll chip in $5 today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/117400924/576353057/43140476?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk953-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxM2E4MjBkOS1hOWFhLWYwMTEtOGU2MS02MDQ1YmRlZDhiYTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aQRXvv8ZkAf9HxeAIC-8U2IM6W4NFAPqFC2MNhSevkY=)_**
Coloradans deserve a governor who acknowledges that kids growing up today are facing challenges unlike any in human history – from the echo chambers and addictive algorithms of social media to the effects of COVID-19's isolation to heightened economic and political tensions and more – all of which have combined to compromise our kids' mental health.
**So as governor, I plan to pursue and enact the strongest online child-protection policies nationwide.**
I'm talking about a **statewide cellphone ban in schools** ; increased **parental controls** for kids under 13; commonsense **guardrails on AI** chatbots; **limits on designs that hook users** for hours on end; **stronger age verification; moderation and privacy** policies; and above all, **giving kids a seat at the table and a voice in the conversation** – because we all have a role to play.
It's all part and parcel of my guiding belief: that we all share a responsibility to look out for one another and for the next generation. We have to take this on together.
And if we take bold action together under this plan, I believe that we can make Colorado the best state to grow up as a kid in the digital age –**but I first have to earn your support to win this race.**
**_[So if you're in a position to contribute today, friend, I'd really appreciate it. name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: Charlie always believed this day would come
body:
[unsubscribe](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xul=65a6x69jow166jo1opkmvmi0rlucmuh1wdhd6owjlzzzwqfh3up51nk3rqj0hfgeiug5pewsmjgfdkihidqy1lu03y85yv598&__stmp=t48h2b&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
---
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *
| | | | [](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?xtl=qwikcdl711u75uikxr6j0fpg0b176lpqb99q9yw8sz6ux5ceh60401wd4xiz43jho16dhr6tx71d7p5xncogr482d18lz698tphiwdkc9hmmobgi4axe9hjq0jt6vha2gx3&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.thedcbugle.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48h2b&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏
---
4940 East Beverly Road
Phoenix, Arizona 85044
---

null, it’s Haley.

I’ve been texting with my campaign team, and I had to reach out. I’m just feeling so grateful.
**Thanks to this incredible grassroots community, we hit yesterday's critical mid-month fundraising goal.**

This news may not make the front page, but to me, it means everything. Especially since we just reported our best fundraising numbers of any Democrat in this race – and polls show I’m statistically tied with Republican Mike Rogers.
This is what momentum looks like, null.

In fact, GOP operatives told _The Hill_ that I’d be their toughest general election opponent. That’s not spin. Powered by real people: That’s the truth of this movement.

And I wanted to say **thank you.**
**_Thank you_** for believing in me and a campaign built by and for working families.

**_Thank you_** for showing up and chipping in when the stakes couldn’t be higher.

**_Thank you_** for proving that we don’t need MAGA billionaires from Texas to compete – just determination, grit, and grassroots support.
Here’s the truth: **Everything we’ve accomplished so far is because of supporters like you.**

But I’m not naïve. I know we’re just getting started. Mike Rogers is endorsed by Donald Trump, has super-rich GOP megadonors behind him, and we know they’re planning to spend tens of millions to flip Michigan red.
**To win this battleground race, we need to keep building**. We need to keep reaching independent voters, expanding our team, and making sure every Michigander hears our message.

So as we celebrate this mid-month goal and look ahead, I hope you’ll stay in the fight with me.
**_[If you’re able, would you chip in $5 – or whatever you can – to help us keep going strong, fight back against the millions coming our way, and win this race in Michigan?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/7110?t=3&akid=1111%2E49239%2EeevW1m)_**
| | [Donate](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/7111?t=4&akid=1111%2E49239%2EeevW1m)
---
I'm grateful for you, null.

Haley
|
* * *
**A note from Haley Stevens:** null, I’m proud to be a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. That’s why I’ve fought so hard for working families my entire life. Now, I’m running for Michigan’s open Senate seat to continue fighting for the people and communities I love. The path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan, which means this race is shaping up to be the most competitive and expensive in the entire country. The GOP is already coming after me as a top target for defeat, so I’m counting on your grassroots support to fight back and win. [**If you’re in this fight with me, will you add your name to endorse my campaign?**](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/7112?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=5&akid=1111%2E49239%2EeevW1m) | | | [](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/7109?t=6&akid=1111%2E49239%2EeevW1m)

# JPM Morgan bets big on Trump's mining charge with $1.5 Trillion investment initiative
JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon **[unveiled a massive $1.5 trillion](https://substack.com/redirect/dd3d60d6-8472-499c-9996-75176cb02f02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Security and Resiliency Initiative Monday, pledging up to $10 billion initially to slash U.S. dependence on China for critical minerals vital to U.S. national security amid escalating global tensions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd3d60d6-8472-499c-9996-75176cb02f02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Targeting Four Critical Sectors** : Dimon's initiative funnels investments into supply chains, defense-aerospace, energy resilience, and frontier technologies to rebuild domestic production.
* **Dimon 's Urgent Warning**: "Adversaries aren't waiting--we need speed now," Dimon declared, highlighting America's perilous over-reliance on unreliable foreign sources.
* **China 's Mineral Monopoly**: Beijing controls 60% of global rare earth production and 90% of refining, which fuels smartphones, batteries, and weapons production while the U.S. lags critically behind.
* **Political Mining Flashpoint** : Trump's reversal of Biden's Alaska road block on mining for copper and gold deposits, sparking Democratic outcry, is seen as a first step in an all fronts attempt to reverse America's decline in the mineral refining and mining sectors.

* **Silver Liquidity Crunch Emerges** : Over 15 million ounces of Silver were withdrawn from New York warehouses last week, with prices hitting a $53 record.

---|---|---
* **Frantic Hunt To Cover Paper** **With Metal:** Silver prices dipped initially after hitting the $53 level, but ETF inflows eroded London stocks, sparking a global hunt for physical. The price has now rebounded above $53 with the prospect of a "Silver Squeeze" back on.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6ee45d66-482b-4d5c-a84b-05a738cf6f39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

# Chat GPT is about to get frisky says Altman
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman **[sparked online fury](https://substack.com/redirect/bf9138c0-a1f1-46a4-a538-9a23b4443959?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Wednesday by defending loosened ChatGPT restrictions allowing erotica, insisting his firm isn't the "elected moral police" while vowing to shield users from harm amid intensifying safety scrutiny.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bf9138c0-a1f1-46a4-a538-9a23b4443959?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Altman Rejects Moral Overreach** : OpenAI CEO declared that the company won't police global ethics, prioritizing adult user autonomy over blanket content bans in recent X posts.
* **Erotica Policy Sparks Backlash** : The announcement to permit erotic content on ChatGPT exploded into controversy, prompting Altman's clarifications about treating adults responsibly.
* **Safety Upgrades Enable Relaxations** : After tackling severe mental health risks, OpenAI expanded protections--especially for minors--allowing "safe" easing of most restrictions.
* **Boundaries Echo Societal Norms** : Altman likens AI limits to R-rated films, prohibiting only harmful material while balancing innovation with ethical safeguards.

* * *

# Paypal's crypto partner accidentally created $300 trillion worth of tokens
In a **[stunning crypto blunder](https://substack.com/redirect/03cef503-81ab-4d38-beca-42b9e702810a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , PayPal's blockchain partner Paxos accidentally minted $300 trillion in PYUSD stablecoins--far exceeding global GDP--during an internal transfer on Wednesday, sparking fears over stablecoin safeguards before swiftly burning the excess.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/03cef503-81ab-4d38-beca-42b9e702810a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive Minting Exposed** : Paxos's Ethereum blockchain transaction revealed the erroneous creation of PYUSD tokens valued at $300 trillion, detected by market watchers via Etherscan explorer.
* **Rapid Error Contained** : Within 20 minutes, Paxos burned the unauthorized tokens, confirming no security breach occurred and restoring normal operations without delays.
* **Customer Safety Assured** : All user funds remained untouched and secure, as emphasized in Paxos's official statement, with PYUSD's dollar backing intact via U.S. treasuries and deposits.
* **Peg Vulnerabilities Highlighted** : Incident reveals PYUSD's stability depends on external PayPal guarantees rather than minting mechanics, amid stablecoin market cap surpassing $2.6 billion for this sixth-ranked token.

* * *
* * *
# Former senior Meta advisor has a harsh warning for AI and his old boss
Former Meta executive Nick Clegg **[warned Wednesday on CNBC's "Squawk Box](https://substack.com/redirect/8ef13857-754d-40bc-a973-bf4574870e3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/8ef13857-754d-40bc-a973-bf4574870e3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Europe" that the AI sector faces a "pretty high" chance of market correction amid "crazy valuations" and hype over superintelligence, though the transformative technology will endure despite a likely downturn.
* **AI Boom Signals Correction** : Ex-Meta leader Nick Clegg highlights an "absolute spasm" of deal-making **[fueling unsustainable hyperscaler investments](https://substack.com/redirect/76d79fbd-5d19-4323-8064-93072e1f44c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in data centers worth hundreds of billions, risking unrecouped costs if business models falter.
* **Superintelligence Hype Challenged** : Clegg pushes back on pursuits by Meta's Mark Zuckerberg and SoftBank's Masayoshi Son, arguing large language models have fundamental limits and won't achieve the "holy grail" of surpassing human intelligence as quickly as claimed.

* **Adoption Pace Underestimated** : Silicon Valley's "invent Tuesday, use Thursday" optimism ignores reality, Clegg says, citing 20-year desktop computing rollout as evidence that AI integration will vary slowly by sector and country.
* **Bubbles Foster Survivors** : Drawing dot-com parallels, Clegg predicts any correction will cull weak players like past busts did, leaving efficient giants such as Meta, Amazon, and Google to thrive by doing "more with less."

body:
Believe me, I wish this was Fake News...
Believe me, I wish this was Fake News...
| | **_A SECURE MEMO TRANSMITTED FROM THE DESK OF REP. JIM JORDAN_**
---
Friend,
---
The Democrats haven’t had much to celebrate recently.
---
**But _CNN_ is taking a victory lap after Democrats added _TWO_ more House seats to their column by winning special elections in Virginia and Arizona!**
_**CNN:
Democrats are doing better than ever in Trump-era special elections**_
“Democrats are over-performing in special elections more than they ever have in the Trump era — dating back to his first term.”
Believe me, I wish this was nothing more than Fake News...
But so far this year, the Democrats have overperformed in all of the House special elections by **_DOUBLE_ _DIGIT_** margins!
The last time Democrats overperformed in special elections with margins anywhere close to these was during President Trump’s first two years in office.
**They went on to FLIP over _40_ House seats in the midterms!**
_And right now, the Democrats are actually doing _BETTER_ than they were back then! _
But there’s one important caveat to all of this: The Democrats aren’t winning special elections by these huge margins because they’re winning more votes.
_Instead, they’re winning because thousands of Republican voters simply aren’t showing up to cast their ballots like they did last November._
**I’ll be perfectly frank with you, Friend: The biggest threat to President Trump’s House majority isn’t from anything the Democrats can do.__It’s from our own voters getting complacent and not turning out to vote.__**
And since we’re ONLY 1 SEAT over the _bare_ _minimum_ _threshold_ to declare a Majority in the House, we truly have no room for error. Losing even a single seat could prove disastrous!
_Given this troubling trend in special elections, I’ve been tasked with determining _exactly_ who President Trump and I can count on to show up and vote in the midterms. _
_I just need one thing from you before I can officially mark you as “verified,” Friend._

| Dear Fellow American,

Justice and accountability have finally moved forward with the indictment of former FBI Director James Comey.

This isn't just a headline. **It 's a win that proves the effectiveness of Judicial Watch's strategic, long-game efforts to defend the rule of law**.

You see, Judicial Watch has been pursuing accountability for James Comey for _nearly a decade_ with hard-fought legal battles and relentless pressure powered by loyal patriots.

Our supporters invest, then we fight. For as long as it takes.

Here is a recap of our litigation and investigative efforts surrounding James Comey:

* In June 2016 **Judicial Watch sent Acting FBI Director Andrew G. McCabe a warning letter**on the FBI's legal responsibility to recover memos Comey unlawfully removed from the Bureau and leaked to the media.
* In January 2018, a **Judicial Watch****lawsuit forced the FBI **to turn over Comey memos allegedly detailing conversations he had with President Donald Trump.
* In February 2018, **in response to a****Judicial Watch****lawsuit** , the FBI agreed to review 16,750 pages of Comey's records archived after he was dismissed.
* In May 2018, **emails uncovered by Judicial Watch** showed the FBI advised Comey to consult with Special Counsel Robert Mueller prior to testifying before Congress on Russian meddling in the 2016 presidential election and his firing as FBI director.
* In August 2018, a federal court ordered the Justice Department to preserve federal records located in Comey's personal email accounts - **our efforts were starting to pay off.

**
* And in July 2019, **Judicial Watch uncovered FBI records** from just one month after President Trump fired Comey in 2017 showing that FBI agents visited his home and collected "as evidence" four memos allegedly detailing conversations between Comey and the President.

The path toward bringing Comey to justice has not been easy or short.

_The Deep State has tried to bury the truth_.

_We 've been constantly told that we should just "move on" from corruption scandals.

_And of course, getting any action from the Comey-complicit Biden Administration from 2020 through 2024 was a non-starter.
**But even when James Comey 's name left the headlines, your _Judicial Watch_ never stopped working behind the scenes to ensure he could eventually be held accountable.
**
It has been the gifts of _Americans just like you_ who _kept us in the fight to expose the truth_.

There would be little awareness among the American public today of the Deep State conspiracy against President Trump in his first term without Judicial Watch donors - Financial support makes government accountability possible.
| [Your Support Today Will Help Judicial Watch Fight as Long as It Takes to Hold MORE Deep State Actors Accountable ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77216&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Comey's crimes are legion, but this indictment is one small step toward holding accountable those who engaged in the worst political abuse in the history of the country.

Many of the same operatives who shielded Comey are also protecting the Biden family, the CIA, and the corrupt actors in the Justice Department itself.

**Fortunately, Judicial Watch is on the job, and we 'll never stop fighting to expose corruption and shine sunlight on the truth.**

Today, we are also taking action against Joe Biden and corrupt operatives in his former Administration, to include:

* Exposing Joe and Hunter Biden's corrupt family business dealings in Ukraine. Judicial Watch's lawsuit forced the release of records revealing how Joe blended personal and taxpayer-funded communications and travel for his family to make money overseas.
* Investigating Joe Biden's unprecedented pardon of his son Hunter and use of his power to protect his political allies from justice. Judicial Watch is suing the Justice Department for records on the Hunter Biden blank check pardon.
* We are suing for records from Biden's State Department for any records where they called President Trump or a member of his Administration a "Disinformation Purveyor".
* Another lawsuit of ours on Biden's censorship operation uncovered records of his Department of Homeland Security showing an extensive effort by government entities to monitor and censor social media posts on fraud during the 2020 election.

We're already seeing wins: Judicial Watch recently sued and won to get the FULL interview of Joe Biden by Special Counsel Robert Hur in his criminal investigation of Biden released to the public (an interview his Administration was forced to admit they edited).

All this is just the beginning of accountability for Biden and his ilk.

__And the Comey indictment proves our long-game methods will work. The donors who stood with us ten years ago are seeing their faith pay off today__.

[Contributing to Judicial Watch Is a Smart Long-Term Investment in Government Accountability and Transparency ](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77216&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

**Imagine what your support could do over the next ten years.

** While politicians posture and pundits chase headlines, Judicial Watch does the heavy lifting. Filing lawsuits, uncovering records, and fighting in court for the rule of law.

And if you join with us, we will keep up the work - however long it takes.

_[That's why I'm asking you to invest in the next decade of wins right now](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=77216&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)_.

clean_body: I'm fighting for my family. And yours. | | | | | | | It’s Josh Hawley. Some of you may know me as Missouri’s Senator. Others may remember me for standing with President Trump when it mattered most. But before politics, I’m a husband, a father of three, and an unapologetic Christian. My wife, Erin, is a constitutional lawyer who defends our freedoms every single day. And together, we’re raising our kids—Elijah, Blaise, and Abigail—to know that their value comes not from Washington or woke ideology, but from God. Right now, I’m fighting the greatest threat to our families and our future: Big Tech. | | I love my kids too much to let the tech oligarchs impose their agenda on my family. And I know you feel the same about yours. Silicon Valley has run roughshod over modern civilization—and they’re just getting started. Smartphones addict our children. Social media tracks their every click, pause, and purchase. Every so-called “innovation” has been nothing more than a power grab—taking power from us, straight into their hands. And now, the tech elite has turned with rabid enthusiasm to artificial intelligence. Make no mistake: this isn’t about helping Americans—it’s about replacing them. AI-powered robots threaten to automate entire industries. Over 3.5 million trucking jobs wiped out with self-driving vehicles. Delivery drivers, taxi workers, and customer service reps—eliminated in the name of “efficiency.” Millions of entry-level jobs—gone overnight. This isn’t progress. It’s the destruction of the working class. I’m Josh Hawley, and I’m leading the fight to stop Big Tech from stealing our children’s attention, personal data and their very future! But I refuse to stand by while powerful billionaires replace American workers and rob our kids of opportunity. Will you stand with me? | | In Liberty, Josh Hawley | | | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for by Josh Hawley Victory Committee | | |

subject: This partisan brinkmanship is dangerous
body:

I wanted to reach out personally to you, Peter.

Republicans have refused to work with Democrats on a responsible budget, and I’m deeply concerned about what their partisan brinkmanship means for our community.

Under their current budget proposal, 25,000 people in CA-27 would see their health care costs skyrocket if ACA tax credits expire, and 40,000 could lose coverage entirely due to massive Medicaid cuts.

I was elected to fight for affordable health care, so you’d better believe I refuse to support any budget that hurts the people I represent. Full stop.

And during this shutdown, I’ve tried to live those values. While federal workers and active duty military go without pay, I’ve chosen to donate my congressional salary to Meals on Wheels in Santa Clarita and the Antelope Valley. I’m also pushing for the No Pay for Congress During Default or Shutdown Act to bar members of Congress from getting paid during any shutdown.

If Washington can’t do its job, politicians shouldn’t get paid. It’s as simple as that. This shutdown reminds me why I ran for Congress in the first place: to stand up for those who can’t afford to be political pawns.

Thank you,

George

Before you go:

Your support has kept our campaign strong, even as chaos unfolds in Washington. CA-27 remains a key seat for House control, and George isn’t backing down – even though it makes him even more of a Republican target.

Please consider chipping in $3 to keep George keep fighting for CA-27 and push us closer to our goal.
