The Patriot Pack — Smoke for the Bold and the Free

Stand tall and light up freedom with The Patriot Pack from Patriot Cigar Company — a powerful lineup built for true American patriots. **
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Patriot Pack
A Bold Salute to Liberty
------------------------------------------------------------

Raise your colors high — the Patriot Pack from Patriot Cigar Company is the ultimate tribute to freedom, made for those who stand proud. This isn’t just a cigar set; it’s a declaration, a statement, and a smoke-filled salute to the red, white, and blue.

** Included Inside the Patriot Pack
------------------------------------------------------------

**
“The Pledge” Premium Leather 3-Cigar Travel Case
------------------------------------------------------------

Carry your cigars in patriotic style. This rugged yet elegant case is crafted in premium printed leather with the pledge of allegiance, built to safeguard your Patriot Cigars while projecting staunch American pride. Designed for travel, with room for three cigars up to a 60-ring size and a secure closure, it’s more than storage—it’s armor for your freedom smoke.

** Old Glory Cigar Cutter
------------------------------------------------------------

No patriot’s toolkit is complete without a sharp edge. The Old Glory Cigar Cutter is a dual-blade instrument worthy of the name. It slices clean and precise, honoring the flag with every snip (and making sure your draw is perfect).
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Finest Blends Under the Flag
------------------------------------------------------------

** TNT
------------------------------------------------------------

Explosive in flavor and bold in character, TNT is a powerhouse medium to full blend that commands your attention. From first light to the last ember, it burns with authority.

** MOAB (Mother of All Bombs)
------------------------------------------------------------

MOAB delivers a full-bodied punch, a maduro cigar that lives up to its name. Deep, rich, and intense — this is not for the faint of heart but for the true patriot who demands maximum firepower in flavor.

** Sidewinder
------------------------------------------------------------

Sleek, swift, and sly — the Sidewinder rounds out the pack with a medium blend that strikes with finesse. Balanced, bold, and full of character, it’s the curveball every patriotic smoker needs.

The Patriot Pack doesn’t stop there, you’ll also get a Patriot-branded beverage koozie, coaster, sticker, and patch—because every smoke session deserves a touch of American pride.
------------------------------------------------------------

** Why the Patriot Pack Matters
------------------------------------------------------------

This is not merely a sampler or gift set. The Patriot Pack is your on-demand arsenal of American spirit and premium craftsmanship. It’s a perfect companion for travel, a striking gift for fellow flag-bearers, or your own daily reminder that freedom is worth celebrating — one premium puff at a time.

Light up The Patriot Pack. Puff with pride. And let the smoke carry your pledge to liberty.

** Uncompromising Quality, Made for Patriots
------------------------------------------------------------

At Patriot Cigar Company, every cigar is handcrafted in Estelí, Nicaragua, using premium-aged tobacco (aged a minimum of three years). Our blends were born from the desire to bring together the love of premium smokes and the love of our country, forging a brand built on passion and pride.

body:
Adelita Grijalva was elected to represent Arizona’s 7th district in Congress but Mike Johnson has used this government shutdown as an excuse to refuse to swear her into office.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1894%2E791427%2Es4XGJn)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-oct25-grijalva/?source=em251016-1-180&akid=1894%2E791427%2Es4XGJn)
Friend — Adelita Grijalva was elected to represent Arizona’s 7th district in Congress on September 23rd, over three weeks ago.
Unfortunately, GOP Speaker Mike Johnson has used this government shutdown as an excuse to refuse to swear her into office and let her get to work representing her constituents.
It’s an abandonment of his duty as Speaker and an insult to the people of Arizona’s 7th, who have been without representation for months.
And the reason for this unprecedented move is clear: When Rep. Grijalva is seated in Congress, she will become the 218th vote to finally begin to release the Epstein files. That’s a big problem for Trump and the GOP.
We already know from extensive reporting by independent news outlets that Trump’s names appear throughout the Epstein files. We know that Trump and Jeffrey Epstein were close friends. We know that the FBI and Attorney General are refusing to release these files to protect the President.
In the eyes of the White House and Republicans in Congress, the longer they can fend off another news cycle about Trump’s involvement with Epstein, the better.
And honestly, this is even bigger than the Epstein files alone. The GOP has become even more far-right under Trump, testing the limits of our democracy and our Constitution.
If we let Mike Johnson continue to deny a democratically elected representative their place in Congress, we will send a signal that Republicans can play fast and loose with our democracy. Would could put ourselves on track towards a future where Republicans deny Democrats their seats in Congress as a way to ensure one-party rule. We have to act.
**[Please, sign on to Ilhan Omar’s petition today calling for Mike Johnson to swear in Adelita Grijalva immediately. We have to put pressure on from all sides before this becomes a full-blown constitutional crisis.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-oct25-grijalva/?source=em251016-1-180&akid=1894%2E791427%2Es4XGJn)

Team Ilhan

body:

[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/96637?refcode=em20251016-9581&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9581%2E614464%2Eg6NrNf)
Peter,
Nothing pisses me off more than getting a fundraising text from Democrats talking about how they’re fighting fascism... Because it’s such B.S. We’re not idiots. Everyone knows most of them aren’t doing jack right now to fight back.
People are being kidnapped into unmarked vans by masked police. There is a genocide happening in Palestine. Literal billionaires have taken over our government. And all Democratic leadership can do is send us another fundraising text?
**My name is Graham Platner, and I’m the Marine Corps veteran and Democrat running for U.S. Senate against Susan Collins here in Maine.** I’m not going to speak in platitudes or shy away from what I believe. There is a war going on in this country, and the oligarchy and the fascists are winning right now.
**Susan Collins is the most vulnerable Republican senator in the country.** We have an opportunity to replace her with a working-class Democrat – one who won’t take money from corporations or AIPAC.
But I’m not a wealthy guy, and we’re still short of our $50,000 goal and what we need to win. **If I’m going to be able to defeat Susan Collins and flip this Senate seat blue, I need folks like you to chip in now to our campaign.**
**[Please, will you split a donation right now between our campaign and Heartland Patriots to help me defeat Susan Collins, flip Maine blue, and take back the Senate with a Democrat who will actually fight to defend our democracy like Democrats oughta be?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/96637?refcode=em20251016-9581&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=9581%2E614464%2Eg6NrNf)**
In the history of this nation, power has never been just willingly handed to the people. Another mealy-mouthed Democrat isn’t going to fix things or protect our constitution.
I’m ready to go to the United States Senate and fight – but I need your help today to get there.
In solidarity,
Graham Platner

| | **_Meet Rob:_** Rob Bresnahan is a fifth generation Northeastern Pennsylvanian serving his first term in Congress as the Representative for Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District. A product of the American Dream, Rob learned the true meaning of hard work at an early age. He learned the ins and outs of the electrical industry by wiring junction boxes, running heavy equipment, driving trucks, and getting his hands dirty. In the process, he learned about the real-world challenges facing America’s blue-collar workers. At just 19 years old, Rob joined his family’s business as the CFO for Kuharchik Construction. He became the CEO of the company in 2013. The sole member of the National Electrical Contractors Association serving in the People’s House, Rob spent over a decade working and connecting with blue-collar Americans across the country before running for Congress in 2024. He’s learned exactly how far-left energy policies coming out of Washington have strangled the American energy sector. And sadly, he’s seen the destructive impacts these policies have had on Pennsylvania’s blue-collar workers first-hand. But the people of Northeastern Pennsylvania demanded change in November 2024 when they sent Rob to Congress. Through his work in Washington, Rob is 100% devoted to restoring America’s energy independence, deregulating the economy, and bringing well-paying jobs back to our great commonwealth.

Hi, it's Shawn Harris, the Democrat running to unseat Marjorie Taylor Greene. When I say I'm a _Dirt Road Democrat,_ I don't mean it as a slogan. I mean it as a way of life.
---
| [ ](http://clicksp.shawnharrisforcongress.com/f/a/jfAUNeAwB0_yxMkibiWmHg~~/AAPPABA~/CVVFBV-Sv8dgCVv14qMln0n_2ZzdeNJjRYDibHpWN8LIWZDXDBAVvYRkBpXpaVH--1m_5DXpBX3p6dkQAW_DQs_NiIEpl0ZZFcwKhAk4Y49dZdN2AeAumoUZMuT-MjreLUCNyHK3JYGkjKxlaYkZDnmAHT1SjqDi3E3akGvsxeG1EeNCADwxr4HgcNzhtyf3QuGjYzbWcqX5FMVy1SnWN1VsDb7khcvFKWc3TYdS2n52G0wst7JFuPcNxmWm72COSvWwViyMRovifsfMbYgT0w~~)

Being a Dirt Road Democrat means more than identifying with where we live--it means standing up for the values rural communities care about most:**_fairness, opportunity, and dignity._** For too long, rural Georgia has been treated like an afterthought. Our **hospitals** have shut their doors, our **farmers** face rising costs and shrinking margins, and our**small towns** have lost jobs while politicians in Washington argue on TV. Meanwhile, Marjorie Taylor Greene has spent her time chasing headlines instead of delivering results. That's not leadership--it's abandonment. We're building something different. Being a Dirt Road Democrat is about showing up everywhere, fighting for affordable healthcare, protecting Social Security and Medicare, investing in local schools, and making sure rural Georgia has the same shot at prosperity as anyone else. [**And we 're not just building a campaign--we're building a movement. That's why I'm asking you to take the first step with me: Will you add your name to let me know that YOU are a Dirt Road Democrat?**](http://clicksp.shawnharrisforcongress.com/f/a/jfAUNeAwB0_yxMkibiWmHg~~/AAPPABA~/CVVFBV-Sv8dgCVv14qMln0n_2ZzdeNJjRYDibHpWN8LIWZDXDBAVvYRkBpXpaVH--1m_5DXpBX3p6dkQAW_DQs_NiIEpl0ZZFcwKhAk4Y49dZdN2AeAumoUZMuT-MjreLUCNyHK3JYGkjKxlaYkZDnmAHT1SjqDi3E3akGvsxeG1EeNCADwxr4HgcNzhtyf3QuGjYzbWcqX5FMVy1SnWN1VsDb7khcvFKWc3TYdS2n52G0wst7JFuPcNxmWm72COSvWwViyMRovifsfMbYgT0w~~)

name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is so good
body:
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.

* * *
| | | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?xtl=2vytyz4021zmw1isfx0mhugorqw0g1k79sh3hnmuo0xwu050bi3gatwcb8oyp8y0rlf1if7f79e4bz7en358hj7de5gtmu4f99piwrpndlr8e3oc5hbb6rfn1q5f1kb9h2ji79sihta&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48lxg&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏
---

Phoenix, Arizona 85044
---

**** Friend, I’m Jeff Person, founder of Able Dems, a proud gay man, and a person with disabilities. And I’ll tell you this right now. I’m not afraid. _I’m furious._ The Supreme Court, stacked by Trump, is deciding whether to strike down Colorado’s ban on abusive “conversion therapy” - a dangerous, fraudulent practice that’s driven LGBTQ+ kids to depression, trauma, and suicide. That’s who we are up against. **At Able Dems, we’re fighting back to defend every kid’s right to safety, dignity, and love. Because no child should ever grow up believing they’re broken. Not for who they love. name: Tobias Read
subject: “Like living in hell”: President Trump says Portland will be next city to see National Guard on streets
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251005em-portland-pet-rs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251005em-portland-pet-rs]
Hi, it’s Oregon Secretary of State, Tobias Read.
After weeks of attacking our state, President Trump ordered troops to Portland.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251005em-portland-pet-rs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251005em-portland-pet-rs]
In the weeks leading up to this decision, he has stood in the Oval Office and called Portland “like living in hell.” He has even attacked our neighbors as “paid terrorists.”
The Portland I know is a beautiful, vibrant, and resilient city. It’s a place where families build their futures, where communities come together, and where people stand up for justice.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251005em-portland-pet-rs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=251005em-portland-pet-rs]
Like many other major cities across the country, Portland has faced its share of challenges. Denying this doesn’t help move Portland and Oregon forward.
At the same time, Portland is a city worth supporting — not demonizing.

subject: God is moving
body:
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?xtl=1apjtn1vd0n81f6h1i1wq8iur771k6vqx34h01mcgpy15orltzf4vdqa0211je8dvl97ul0gkuii1nv01bflw6g8rrsrg47srkl9fdxpp1ux2qs22xsxf9z&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h) [Mark as Spam](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?xul=t2p76x2ul3l184ws2kiv1kps6pc7cetxy5p5we114sfl8ebtmkmmk8pxf5b5jlc2j3kzw224n5427t0maatlabafrhf3dao5r24rjqtkxg&__stmp=t48mr5&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh) | [Unsubscribe](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?xul=t2p76x2ul3l184ws2kiv1kps6pc7cetxy5p5we114sfl8ebtmkmmk8pxf5b5jlc2j3kzw224n5427t0maatlabafrhf3dao5r24rjqtkxg&__stmp=t48mr5&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
---
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *

| | | | [](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?xtl=u3vjmpooycjuw7vvdvg3tmr6neiodonbf4fk5x2px7a0zoz4vyvmu2f1g04fskh6789ssymga8lqtsqphkj4h9x0o571gr80a69n7z15f58hkfcurnwuntq9qi94kel2ol61lmcxqzt9&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](http://trk.2025battleground.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48mr5&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏
---
4940 East Beverly Road
Phoenix, Arizona 85044
---

body:
I didn’t risk my life overseas just to watch a bunch of self-serving cowards run our country into the ground.

[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-7lVD09jC_omOBhLrg)If you hate BS political emails, good. You’re exactly who I want to talk to, Peter.
This is Troy Downing.
I’m a combat vet, not a career politician. I didn’t risk my life overseas just to watch a bunch of self-serving cowards run our country into the ground.
I ran for Congress — and won — because I tell the truth and fight for __We the People__ , not party bosses, lobbyists, or woke elites.**
****And because I refuse to play their games, the Left is coming after my GOP House seat.**[ RUSH HELP
](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-Htme2GKkCfo-jSQEOPLw)They want me out because I call out their radical agenda, support President Trump, and won’t back down on the issues that matter.
In other words, I’m “ _deplorable._ ”
“ _Garbage_.”
“ _MAGA Extremist_.”
They can label me whatever they want, but I guarantee you it won’t stop me from standing up to open-border policy and the mutilation of our kids in the name of “gender ideology.”
But here's the real problem: **Democrats are pummeling us with cash. **
They’ve stockpiled a **_$40 MILLION advantage over Republicans_** , aiming it straight at flipping the House Majority.
If I don’t flip the switch on fundraising soon, defending this seat will be nearly impossible.
And if we lose it, we don’t just lose my seat. We’ll lose our only chance at advancing President Trump’s America First agenda.
I’m not asking for a handout. I’m asking for an ally. [If you’re ready to join this fight, will you chip in $15.50 today?](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-g)[JOIN THE FIGHT
](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)[DONATE TODAY
](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)Thank you for your patriotic support,
-Troy Downing** _Combat Veteran in Congress_**| |

subject: Charlie always believed this day would come
body:

Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *
| | | | [](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](http://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?xtl=71kqox8yyg2af7v1dx1w78yjaudb6wsg4uvrcd9acatxs3oeqf96do9hvoaarkssker28odt88ff3584r7wb1hze1vp281jptn1pwxunsz0dmokt6xx5b7p3kupuungjt9fa5vigsld72domg7ts&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48n65&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**

Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏

body:
Parental Rights Debate Deepens After Supreme Court Rejects Colorado Case
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Check out today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Douglas County approved a land exchange deal for a [$85 million Zebulon Sports Hub](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Meanwhile, critics say state energy and housing mandates are [eroding home-rule authority](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and threatening rural autonomy. The parental rights debate also intensified after the [U.S. Supreme Court declined to hear a Colorado case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) involving schools concealing gender-identity discussions from parents — prompting concern from Justices Alito, Thomas, and Gorsuch over parental authority. And across northern Colorado, progressive groups like the Working Families Party are [pouring resources into local school board and city races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to flip historically conservative regions.
**🇺🇸 On the National Stage...** President Trump posthumously awarded Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk the [Presidential Medal of Freedom](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), calling him a “fearless warrior for liberty” who inspired a generation of young conservatives. At the same time, new revelations show the January 6 Committee secretly collected 30 million lines of Americans’ private phone data — [including Trump White House contacts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) — and later handed it to the FBI without a warrant.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** In _It’s YOUR Money – Not The Government’_ s, Russ Minary warns that [America’s $36 trillion debt](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) has left the nation “technically insolvent,” urging citizens to demand fiscal restraint before an economic collapse mirrors the Great Depression. Meanwhile, Cory Gaines argues that vague conservation policies risk [crippling Colorado’s $40 billion ag industry](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by labeling agriculture as a “threat.” And in Results Speak for Themselves, Kent Zook [praises Mesa County’s District 51 school board](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for delivering higher test scores and teacher pay — proof that conservative governance gets results.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, October 16, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Parental Rights Debate Deepens After Supreme Court Rejects Colorado Case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CBS NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The Supreme Court on Monday rejected a bid to revive a lawsuit brought by two Colorado families who alleged their parental rights were violated when their children attended school-sponsored club meetings that included discussions of gender identity and sexuality and were allegedly discouraged from telling their parents about it.
Though the high court turned away the case, Justices Samuel Alito, joined by Justices Clarence Thomas and Neil Gorsuch, wrote separately to express concern with what Alito said was an unwillingness by courts to confront whether a school district violates parents’ rights when it encourages a student’s gender transition without the parents’ knowledge or consent.
“Petitioners tell us that nearly 6,000 public schools have policies — as respondent allegedly does — that purposefully interfere with parents’ access to critical information about their children’s gender-identity choices and school personnel’s involvement in and influence on those choices,” Alito wrote. “The troubling — and tragic — allegations in this case underscore the ‘great and growing national importance” of the question that these parent petitioners present.'”
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Results speak for themselves: The D51 school board has earned re-election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KENT ZOOK, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The author endorses current District 51 school board members Andrea Haitz, Will Jones, and Angela Lema for re-election, praising them for reversing decades of poor academic performance under union control.

* Since taking office, the board has improved school security, prioritized maintenance, and raised starting teacher pay by 33% to $50,000, all without new taxes—leading to lower turnover and top state academic ratings.

* The piece warns that union-backed challengers would undo this progress, citing the union’s history of financial mismanagement and unprofessional behavior at board meetings.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[It’s YOUR Money – Not The Government’s](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY RUSS MINARY, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Russ Minary argues that America’s $36 trillion national debt has left the country “technically insolvent,” growing by $1 trillion every few months and far outpacing the nation’s $30 trillion GDP.

* He compares federal overspending to household debt, warning that printing more money only devalues the dollar—citing how gold has risen from $270 to over $4,100 per ounce in 25 years while purchasing power plummets.

* Minary urges immediate tax and spending cuts, calling on government at all levels to “go on a crash diet” and let Americans keep more of their earnings before the country faces another Great Depression-scale collapse.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****[Two former board presidents urge a course correction for Cherry Creek schools](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**BY JENNIFER CHURCHFIELD & AAGJE BARBER | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 14** As former presidents of the Cherry Creek School Board, we have always believed that the success of our schools begins with a laser focus on students, academic excellence, and responsible stewardship of taxpayer dollars. Today, we write with deep concern — and urgency — about the direction of the district and the need for a course correction. That’s why we are endorsing Amanda Thayer and Tatyana Sturm for the Cherry Creek School Board.

**[At Mesa County rally, Anthony Watson challenges crowd to trade outrage for obedience](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | OCTOBER 13** No bulls, no broncs—the arena lights belonged to a different crowd. Sun broke in strips across a clouded sky after a full day of rain. Over 500 filled the grandstands for a different kind of roundup with local pastors, community leaders and a two-time Olympian. Bookcliff led off with the Star-Spangled Banner and closed beneath candlelight with God Bless America.
**[The sword is passed: Honoring Charlie Kirk’s bold stand for truth](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | OCTOBER 12** _As we conclude this series on The Sword of the Spirit, my heart feels both heavy and hopeful. Heavy, because we mourn the loss of a strong, confident voice for truth and a dear friend of Rocky Mountain Voice—Charlie Kirk. Hopeful, because his legacy shows us the trail we are called to follow, with no exceptions, and in my opinion, there is no better way to close this powerful series._ **[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

That was in the 1920s, when it controlled 23% of the world’s population and approximately 13.7 million square miles of territory—or nearly a quarter of the Earth’s land area.

name: The Democratic National Committee
subject: This will only take 2 minutes of your time
body:
Here is something you can do today to help fight voter suppression:
---
Derek, We’re asking for your help today to protect the right to vote from Trump and his allies’ latest attacks. Here’s what’s going on: First, Trump signed an executive order demanding that documentary proof of citizenship be added to federal voter registration applications. This would make it more difficult for eligible Americans to register to vote — especially married women who have changed their names, because their birth certificates and other citizenship documents may not match their current name. So, the DNC fought back in court against Trump’s attempt to add this requirement. _We stopped him._ But now, Trump’s allies in the America First Legal Foundation — which was co-founded by Stephen Miller — are making their _own_ demand to add this requirement to federal voter registration applications. **We’re asking for your help to fight back, again.** Please, join the DNC in telling the U.S. Election Assistance Commission not to add documentary proof of citizenship requirements to federal voter registration forms. Click the link below to submit a comment and make your voice heard. You can copy and paste a sample comment or make it your own. Here are the instructions on how to help — this will only take two minutes of your time:
* Click the following link: [**www.regulations.gov/submit-a-comment**](https://www.regulations.gov/commenton/EAC-2025-0236-0001?refcode=em_20251016_4901_fr&amount=7).
* Copy and paste the sample comment below or type in your own.
* Click “An Individual” or “Anonymous.”
* Click “I am not a robot.”
* Click “Submit Comment.”

A sample submission:
_I oppose America First Legal Foundation’s petition to add documentary proof of citizenship requirements for federal voter registration applications. This requirement would disenfranchise eligible American citizens by imposing significant new burdens. Documentary proof of citizenship laws creates problems and solves none._ **Comments are due by October 20, so please don’t wait to make your voice heard.** [**This is a fight for the future of our country — and here at the DNC, we are all in. You have the power to help us protect voting rights and preserve our democracy. Please join us and submit a comment rejecting the erosion of our right to vote.**](https://www.regulations.gov/commenton/EAC-2025-0236-0001?refcode=em_20251016_4901_fr&amount=7) Thank you, The Democrats

**Before you go...**

[**If work like this matters to you, please consider making a $7 contribution to the DNC to help support our efforts to protect the right to vote:](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-2025?refcode=em_20251016_4901_fr&amount=7&refcode2=4915_22930333_o2ITru&akid=4915%2E22930333%2Eo2ITru)**[Contribute $7](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-2025?refcode=em_20251016_4901_fr&refcode2=4915_22930333_o2ITru&akid=4915%2E22930333%2Eo2ITru)**

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

name: Eliza Walton
subject: Take action: the 2025 Environmental Scorecard is here!
body:
Read the 2025 Scorecard [https://www.olcvscorecard.org/2025/]
https://www.olcvscorecard.org/2025/ [https://www.olcvscorecard.org/2025/]
Dear Peter,
The harsh and devastating reality of Trump 2.0 has cast a dark shadow over Oregon and the nation. As federal protections for clean air, clean water, public lands, and climate are dismantled one by one, the responsibility to defend Oregon’s people and environment now falls squarely on our state’s leaders.
The 2025 session left much work undone. A transportation package that centers climate and equity stalled. Critical water protections were killed behind the scenes. Conservation and wildlife funding was derailed at the last minute. Even with Democratic supermajorities, Oregon was left playing defense while Trump’s administration advanced a full-scale rollback of environmental protections.
We cannot afford to lose another year. That starts with holding our elected leaders accountable. OLCV’s Environmental Scorecard is exactly the tool to do that, and it was just released today! Check to see how your legislators voted by clicking here [https://www.olcvscorecard.org/2025/] . Now you, Peter, can take action to hold our legislators accountable! [https://secure.everyaction.com/4xdHlmUHAEWUMHXlx-Fq9w2]
Take action [https://secure.everyaction.com/4xdHlmUHAEWUMHXlx-Fq9w2?contactdata=zmlUxCrEevoiSUjAPsqiObmE/7P0s6ehqhN9tQ8fl/wL/iy3ZRZ8T/PpR/cLebpfGO2PwB0oEsvQVG6Lh7tJH8ywsbpQI8ykVdQ9/wVIa31BQEVRedr4mWw6CrQyuKU7]
We expect leadership equal to this moment — leadership that refuses to let Washington, D.C. dictate our future. Leadership that acts with urgency, courage, and moral clarity to defend our state’s values, protect our communities, and build the clean, just, and resilient future we all deserve.
Oregon lawmakers fell short on climate action this past session, so this year we decided not to give out legislative awards in the 2025 Scorecard [https://www.olcvscorecard.org/2025/] , but instead to our volunteers who showed up for our environment. Yet another change we made to the Scorecard [https://www.olcvscorecard.org/2025/] this year was the introduction of a 5% dedication in any legislator’s score who sponsored a Major Threat. This is a response to the increased number of legislators sponsoring Major Threats during the 2025 session, which is deserving of accountability.
That cannot allow a repeat of the 2025 session. Oregonians deserve leaders who take real action. This is the moment for Oregon to lead.
We are calling on Oregon legislators to:
1. Defend Oregon from federal rollbacks. Take bold, proactive action to shield our state’s air, water, land, and communities from the devastating impacts of Trump’s agenda.
2. Center equity and climate in every major policy package. From transportation to revenue, climate justice must guide your decisions.
3. Fund Oregon’s future. Protect investments in natural resources, community resilience, and clean energy programs that are under attack at the federal level.
4. Deliver the climate progress Oregonians demand. The 2026 short session must not be a pause — it must be a launchpad.
It’s time to let our legislators know we are watching, that the people who breathe this air, drink this water, and call Oregon home are counting on them to rise to the challenge.
Take action [https://secure.everyaction.com/4xdHlmUHAEWUMHXlx-Fq9w2?contactdata=zmlUxCrEevoiSUjAPsqiObmE/7P0s6ehqhN9tQ8fl/wL/iy3ZRZ8T/PpR/cLebpfGO2PwB0oEsvQVG6Lh7tJH8ywsbpQI8ykVdQ9/wVIa31BQEVRedr4mWw6CrQyuKU7]
Even as federal protections crumble, Oregon can be — must be — a beacon. A place where we still believe in science, in stewardship, in justice, and in the power of people to make a difference.
Oregon’s future depends on what our legislators do next. Tell your legislators today that it’s time for them to lead boldly, protect what we love, and defend Oregon! [https://secure.everyaction.com/4xdHlmUHAEWUMHXlx-Fq9w2]
Sincerely,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Eliza.png]
Eliza Walton (she/they)
OLCV Coalition Director

clean_body: Read the 2025 Scorecard [] [] Dear Peter, The harsh and devastating reality of Trump 2.0 has cast a dark shadow over Oregon and the nation. As federal protections for clean air, clean water, public lands, and climate are dismantled one by one, the responsibility to defend Oregon’s people and environment now falls squarely on our state’s leaders. The 2025 session left much work undone. A transportation package that centers climate and equity stalled. Critical water protections were killed behind the scenes. Conservation and wildlife funding was derailed at the last minute. Even with Democratic supermajorities, Oregon was left playing defense while Trump’s administration advanced a full-scale rollback of environmental protections. We cannot afford to lose another year. That starts with holding our elected leaders accountable. OLCV’s Environmental Scorecard is exactly the tool to do that, and it was just released today! Check to see how your legislators voted by clicking here [] . Now you, Peter, can take action to hold our legislators accountable! [] Take action [] We expect leadership equal to this moment — leadership that refuses to let Washington, D.C. dictate our future. Leadership that acts with urgency, courage, and moral clarity to defend our state’s values, protect our communities, and build the clean, just, and resilient future we all deserve. Oregon lawmakers fell short on climate action this past session, so this year we decided not to give out legislative awards in the 2025 Scorecard [] , but instead to our volunteers who showed up for our environment. Yet another change we made to the Scorecard [] this year was the introduction of a 5% dedication in any legislator’s score who sponsored a Major Threat. This is a response to the increased number of legislators sponsoring Major Threats during the 2025 session, which is deserving of accountability. That cannot allow a repeat of the 2025 session. Oregonians deserve leaders who take real action. This is the moment for Oregon to lead. We are calling on Oregon legislators to: 1. Defend Oregon from federal rollbacks. Take bold, proactive action to shield our state’s air, water, land, and communities from the devastating impacts of Trump’s agenda. 2. Center equity and climate in every major policy package. From transportation to revenue, climate justice must guide your decisions. 3. Fund Oregon’s future. Protect investments in natural resources, community resilience, and clean energy programs that are under attack at the federal level. 4. Deliver the climate progress Oregonians demand. The 2026 short session must not be a pause — it must be a launchpad. It’s time to let our legislators know we are watching, that the people who breathe this air, drink this water, and call Oregon home are counting on them to rise to the challenge. Take action [] Even as federal protections crumble, Oregon can be — must be — a beacon. A place where we still believe in science, in stewardship, in justice, and in the power of people to make a difference. Oregon’s future depends on what our legislators do next. Tell your legislators today that it’s time for them to lead boldly, protect what we love, and defend Oregon! It is patriotic to support freedom of speech, press, and religion. It is patriotic to defend those rights.
#
It never just stops, Peter.
It didn’t stop with threats on the campaign trail, and it didn’t stop when they brushed Project 2025 under the rug.
It didn’t stop when they started firing military leaders for being insufficiently loyal, and it didn’t stop when they deployed the Marines to Los Angeles.
It didn’t stop when they demanded that every senior leader in the military leave their posts and sit through a speech preparing them for war with American citizens — with the only alternative being to resign or be fired.
And it didn’t stop when they threatened to revoke free press access at the Pentagon, a hallmark of American democracy for generations.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-oct25.PLXLty&refcode=em251016-1-120&t=1&akid=34700%2E3013755%2EP_1ppN)
We fought for those rights. We may not like everything the press has to say, but we would never strip their ability to do their job. That’s what it means to support the Constitution.
We’re betting stuff like that still matters to millions of Americans. It is patriotic to support freedom of speech, press, and religion. It is patriotic to defend those rights. And the war this administration is waging on those rights is an insult to the generations of Americans who fought and died for them.
These people are not patriots — they’re losers. They’re not all powerful, either. We can stop them, but the only way we’ll do that is by standing up and telling these people one word:
**No.**

They're showing up in communities, knocking on doors, and standing up for women and families in every corner of the country. But right now, Republicans are outraising us. That's why we launched our Final Sprint Fund to raise $100k the past three days. | = Behind our fundraising numbers are real-world stakes: more field offices, more support to volunteers, and more ads reaching undecided voters — for our side and theirs. Hi there, It's Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes, and I need to tell you what's happening in Washington right now. House Speaker Mike Johnson is refusing to swear in Arizona's newest member of Congress, Representative-elect Adelita Grijalva. She won her special election on September 23rd. The results were certified. She has her certificate of election. **But Johnson won't let her take the oath of office.** Here's what makes this even worse: Johnson swore in two Republican members during pro forma sessions in April. His excuse for swearing them in and not Adelita? Their families were already in town. When Adelita said her family could come too, he ignored her. **This isn't about procedure. This is about power.** Adelita has been traveling to Capitol Hill for three weeks. She finally got keys to her office on Tuesday – but no internet, no working phones, and she can't hire staff until she's officially sworn in. Meanwhile, the people of Arizona's 7th Congressional District have no representation in Congress. On Tuesday, my office sent Speaker Johnson a letter demanding he swear in Adelita immediately. I gave him two days to respond with a plan, or I'm taking legal action**.** Arizona's right to a full delegation is not up for debate. It cannot be delayed or used as leverage in budget negotiations. The Constitution is clear. When a member is elected and certified, it's a simple duty to administer the oath. Johnson is acting beyond his authority, and I'm going to hold him accountable. It says, “I’m not done yet.” It was the theme of my Army retirement speech. Whenever I hit hard times and thought I was all but finished, I remembered that line. When I faced difficult challenges in life, I dusted myself off and got back in the fight. I’m not done yet.
Missouri is not done yet.
America is not done yet.
We’re not done yet. Trump and his cronies, like Ann Wagner, are using a shock-and-awe strategy to try to beat us into submission. He’s cracking down on media figures who are critical of him. He’s taking thinly veiled bribes left and right. He’s ripping apart the VA. He’s decimating Medicaid and SNAP. There's not a single part of the Constitution that he respects. Ann Wagner and her Republican colleagues in the House have completely walked away from their Article I duties of oversight, investigation, and the power of the purse to allow Trump and his collaborators to do whatever they want, from passing illogical tariffs to simply cutting funds to projects legally passed by Congress with no pushback or resistance. It often feels that America’s challenges are insurmountable. That we’ll never be able to reassemble our democracy or rebuild the American Dream that created the strongest middle class in history. But that’s exactly what Trump wants you to think, Peter. As an Army officer, we were taught to lead by example. That’s why I can’t sit on the sidelines. I’m running for Congress so we can flip the House, restore our Constitution, and rebuild the American Dream for all. If we’re going to get America back on track, we can’t run away from tough fights; we have to run toward them. name: The Turning Point USA Family
subject: God is moving
body:
[Unsubscribe](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?xul=zkl8p045sz1uh88qpcsbcn9r1u5jbslftf8jc3v0ohhc6dcs1u8hh2soz5a4pqcw4o7k3reo2qkp7trn8deem62ageackqmh51h4mffevwape&__stmp=t48q9t&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
---
Please read the message below from Turning Point USA.
* * *

| | | | [](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, Even now... it still doesn't feel real that we lost Charlie. His voice, his courage, his conviction — it shaped all of us. And his vision — **to build the most faithful and the most patriotic generation in American history** — is why Turning Point USA exists today. Friend, that's why we have an inspiring update for you... In just the first seven days since Charlie was taken from all of us, Turning Point USA has received more than 54,000 requests from students who want to start or join a chapter:
---
[](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
**God is so good.** ✝️🙏🕊️ To give you perspective, Friend... Coming into this school year, Turning Point USA had roughly 900+ college chapters and 1,200+ high school chapters. It took us years to build those chapters... over a decade in fact... _But now?_ These students who signed up? They weren't asked to... They weren't recruited... **They felt it was their time to stand up for this country and honor Charlie.** Because of the life he lived. The faith he had. The love he showed God, his family, and others. The courage he had to speak truth. And his vision of a better America for us all.
---
[](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
He always believed this day would come. He used to talk about it all the time — how the momentum would shift, how young people would rise up with courage, and how a Turning Point USA chapter would be in every college and high school in America. And now... _It's happening._ Faster than he could have imagined. Bigger than we thought possible. And more beautiful than we can even describe. **Again, Friend, God is so good.** Since we lost Charlie, we've also felt SO MUCH love... Prayers. Emails. Messages. Stories about how Charlie's voice changed lives... or your children's or grandchildren's lives. And so many supporters have asked, _"What can I do?"_ As you read this, our team is working around the clock to follow up with every chapter request. And we're going to need help equipping them with our activism kits. **Every new chapter receives these kits from Turning Point USA with everything they need to get started — including:** ✅ Leadership materials
✅ Pocket Constitutions
✅ Chapter training tools
✅ American flags & patriotic gear Friend, I'm sure you'd believe it when we say it... _this won't be a small task._ But we're going to do it. Whatever it takes. **_For Charlie._** _And here's how YOU can help with this..._ **Every $25 you give today helps stock another activism kit — ready to deploy into a new Turning Point USA student chapter...** How many of these activism kits can you help provide to the wave of new student chapters that are just getting started?
---
[ **1 KIT = $25**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
[ **2 KITS = $50**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
[ **10 KITS = $250**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
[ **100 KITS = $2,500**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
[ **1,000 KITS = $25,000**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
[ **Sponsor Activism Kits**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, if there was ever a more immediate way you could help make Charlie's vision a reality... **This is it****.**
---
[](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
Also... **Here's one more powerful thing you can do:** 📩 If you have a son, daughter, grandchild, niece, nephew — or any young person in your life — who wants to get involved... who wants to join or start a chapter... **Please send them this link:** **[TPUSAStudents.com/StartaChapter](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?xtl=1wduekwl7wu13gwwvcoyoxt14codopvegr3ukzq1g2o097bew23wqhg6p2xxxifw7a1t5revj3l4hzuhv3e2i9xx7xgjnsdkx4qtwsewow3bq952prafjznequtxsbi8vhkb8r2b9g4djbbs&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)** Friend, if you've already given... If you've already donated... If you've already been a voice of encouragement and strength in this painful week... If you've prayed, been praying, and continue to pray... **Thank you.** We can never say it enough. If you've read this far, we want you to know this... **You're the reason Charlie's mission and vision will grow for generations to come.** God is so good.
---
**For Charlie,** -The Turning Point USA Family **P.S.** Please know, Friend, if you can't afford to help right now, all we ask for are your prayers. Charlie would have wanted you to pray first — and if that's all you can give today, _we're grateful._ But if you're able to help... if you're overjoyed to hear that students are flocking to Charlie's message and mission... Your gift today helps sustain this wave of student inspiration and gets new student chapters off the ground floor... And ensures Charlie's vision is realized faster than we all thought possible. **Every $25 you give today helps us stock another activism kit ready to deploy to a new student chapter.**
---
[ **Sponsor an Activism Kit**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.conservativereboot.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t48q9t&__onlt=h)
---
Thank you for your help and for your prayers, Friend. **God is so good.** 🙏
---
4940 East Beverly Road
Phoenix, Arizona 85044
---

# Protecting Voter Registration
---
| | | |

Team,
We’re asking for your help today to protect the right to vote from Trump and his allies’ latest attacks. Here’s what’s going on:
First, Trump signed an executive order demanding that documentary proof of citizenship be added to federal voter registration applications. This would make it more difficult for eligible Americans to register to vote — especially married women who have changed their names, because their birth certificates and other citizenship documents may not match their current name.
So, the DNC fought back in court against Trump’s attempt to add this requirement. _We stopped him._
But now, Trump’s allies in the America First Legal Foundation — which was co-founded by Stephen Miller — are making their _own_ demand to add this requirement to federal voter registration applications.
**We’re asking for your help to fight back, again.**
Please, join the DNC in telling the U.S. Election Assistance Commission not to add documentary proof of citizenship requirements to federal voter registration forms. Click the link below to submit a comment and make your voice heard. You can copy and paste a sample comment or make it your own.Here are the instructions on how to help — this will only take two minutes of your time:
* Click the following link: [**www.regulations.gov/submit-a-comment**](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=4fa8db4433&e=d6c5c7d7ec).
* Copy and paste the sample comment below or type in your own.
* Click “An Individual” or “Anonymous.”
* Click “I am not a robot.”
* Click “Submit Comment.”

A sample submission:
_I oppose America First Legal Foundation’s petition to add documentary proof of citizenship requirements for federal voter registration applications. This requirement would disenfranchise eligible American citizens by imposing significant new burdens. Documentary proof of citizenship laws creates problems and solves none._
**Comments are due by October 20, so please don’t wait to make your voice heard.**
[**This is a fight for the future of our country — and here at the DNC, we are all in. You have the power to help us protect voting rights and preserve our democracy. Please join us and submit a comment rejecting the erosion of our right to vote.**](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=dba62a7549&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
Thank you,The Democrats

Energy bills are at a record high, and only going up. People are struggling. And our planet is passing dangerous climate tipping points.
That’s why programs like Solar for All matter — lowering energy bills, cutting carbon pollution, and creating good union jobs to boost our economy.
But Trump’s EPA abruptly — and illegally — canceled the program.
I’ve filed two new lawsuits against the EPA to reinstate Solar for All and restore its funding. Add your name to join this fight. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/G3PnzDFYV0K-4i1kA5Gu8g2]
Congress had already appropriated $7 billion to this program, and the EPA had entered into contracts with states. So canceling it now is a breach of contract and a violation of Congress’s power of the purse.
The termination of Solar for All isn’t just unlawful — it’s also totally illogical. Why would the Trump administration undermine an industry that can produce safe, reliable, and inexpensive energy? And that creates high-quality jobs that would benefit American families and our economy?
I’m not going to let this illegal and unnecessary termination stand. Trump’s administration can try all they want to bend the law, but we will hold them accountable. Every time.
Stand with us — add your name to defend Solar for All. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/G3PnzDFYV0K-4i1kA5Gu8g2]

Whether you live in Pennsylvania or not, this election will impact you. A potential suppressive state Supreme Court could mean redistricting to unfair maps, leading to skewed representation in Congress.
Just like we've seen in North Carolina, control of the state Supreme Court can impact control of a few House seats and be enough to keep a suppressive majority in place in Congress.
Fuel our voter outreach efforts with $15 or whatever you can right now to help defend voting rights in Pennsylvania and beyond >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-infrastructure?refcode=101625_3&amount=15]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Bolts: Inside the Clunky Elections to Control Pennsylvania’s Supreme Court [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-infrastructure?refcode=101625_3&amount=25]
folks: We'll keep this short.
Supporters of voting rights currently hold a 5-2 majority of Pennsylvania's state Supreme Court. That majority has been crucial in protecting voters' rights for the last few years , making sure valid ballots were counted and striking down attempts to make it harder for voters to participate in our elections.
Three of those justices are up for renewal in 2025, however, and off year elections like the one just a few weeks away always have depressed turnout and participation. That puts that pro-democracy majority at risk, especially with opponents of voting rights throughout Pennsylvania pulling out all the stops to try and take out these judges, which would force the court into an immediate 2-2 tie.
There is one final, crucial piece of this puzzle: Polls show most voters don't pay a ton of attention to judicial elections or know what is at stake. “ People have no idea, ” said one political volunteer recently at the annual Ephrata, PA street fair. “ Even informed voters—they just don’t know .”
That's where we come in -- trying to inform Pennsylvania voters of what is at stake and asking our supporters to reach out to any friends and family who are Pennsylvania voters to make sure they go out and vote in this critical election.
This all takes resources from grassroots supporters like you. Will you chip in $15 or whatever you can today to help us reach every voter we can ahead of their next election? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-infrastructure?refcode=101625_3&amount=15]

name: Chris Ahuja
subject: I was quoted in Axios this week. Let’s talk about it.
body:
Leadership Should Serve People, Not PACs.

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=fe68e2ea00&e=5a6ee82cdb)
| | | | | |

Dear Peter,
**This week,**_**Axios**_**published a story about Democrats running for Congress** , and how many of us feel about the status quo of party leadership.**This is my direct quote to Axios:**
_"In terms of Hakeem Jeffries, if I would vote for him, right now I probably wouldn't. ... I'm not trying to pick on him, but this is what most Democrats feel: I forget what holiday it was, a few months ago, where he came out [and gave a speech] and he was really adamant, and then he was like, 'Alright, have a good weekend.' We can't have a good weekend! What are you talking about? Our Democrat leaders have to be willing to put it all on the line and not give up. They look like they're giving up."_**Leadership shouldn’t be about protecting your donor list — it should be about protecting your constituents.** Right now, working families are facing record housing costs, unsafe workplaces, unaffordable healthcare, and ICE is running rampant over the Constitutional and civil rights of Americans.**I’m running for Congress because our communities deserve a representative who answers to** _**voters**_**, not to the highest bidder.** Someone who isn’t afraid to say “no” to complacency, or to the party establishment when it forgets who it’s supposed to serve.**This isn’t about dividing Democrats. It’s about demanding better from them.** We can’t keep electing people who play it safe while families are fighting to survive. We need leaders who will take risks for what’s right — and that starts by being honest about who we’re accountable to.**My campaign doesn’t take a dime of AIPAC or corporate PAC money.** It’s fueled entirely by grassroots supporters who believe that courage still matters.****[**If you’re one of them, I hope you’ll chip in $50, $100, or whatever you can today and help us build something new.**](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=ff0853eda4&e=5a6ee82cdb) The establishment may not like that I’m leaning “no.” But the truth is — _I’m leaning toward you._
---
| [Donate](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=8c32fe6c8b&e=5a6ee82cdb)
---
| |
**In solidarity,
**[****](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=4078ac51a6&e=5a6ee82cdb)**Chris Ahuja****Democrat for Congress, CD-32**

body:

Hey Derek, John here with an update:

Housing costs are out of control. Rent’s too high. Buying a home feels impossible. And fixing a leaky roof? The straw that breaks the budget’s back. 🤦

So after witnessing the massive success of PA's Whole-Home Repairs program in helping hardworking people repair (and keep) their homes, I knew this is something we had to bring to the national level.

This could help millions of American families all across this country, so I wrote a bill to do just that. And just last week, the Senate passed the ROAD to Housing Act – a legislative package that included my Whole-Home Repairs bill. 🏠🛠️

By creating grants and forgivable loans for home repair, we're going to be able to help millions fix up their homes. It'll help keep home prices down by protecting housing supply and making a dent in fixing the housing crisis across our country. 💪

It's a step in the right direction, and I hope to see this bipartisan bill get through the House soon and be signed into law.

If yinz are in this with me and want to help make sure we can keep working to find commonsense solutions and support working families, it would mean a lot if you could pitch in a few bucks to help keep this grassroots movement going.

Thanks for all you do,

John ❤️

body:
After helping draft President Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill, I gave up the gavel to my powerful congressional committee to focus my efforts on winning the biggest Senate race in the country for MAGA.

I walked away.
After helping draft President Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill, I gave up the gavel to my powerful congressional committee to focus my efforts on winning the biggest Senate race in the country for MAGA.
Half-measures don’t cut it when God leads you to make the biggest decision of your life.
Some folks thought I was crazy for giving up power like this, but I’d say it’s about the greater good for America.
I can’t stand the idea that a far-left Democrat represents Georgia – my home state in God’s country that President Trump won with ease.
That’s why I’m now devoting my blood, sweat, and tears to flip it back to the GOP. I can say with certainty that with the power of MAGA behind me, this race is ours for the taking. [Will you pitch in a few bucks to help me win the #1 Senate race?](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bmmm/?__vbtrk=MzI3NzUxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzI3NzUxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bmmm/?__vbtrk=MzI3NzUxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzI3NzUxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)Jon Ossoff has a list of Democrat mega-donors a country mile long, so I’ll need a LOT of good folks like you chipping in a couple of bucks here and there to win. [PLEASE DONATE HERE
](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/bmmm/?__vbtrk=MzI3NzUxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MzI3NzUxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)Listen... I'm not some smarmy, silver-spoon politician like Jon Ossoff.
I'm just a South Georgia pharmacist by trade who feels led by God to jump into this race for the good of the country. I’m taking on the entire Democrat machine because they all know Jon Ossoff is the MOST VULNERABLE Senator up for re-election this cycle.
If we can flip this seat, their chances of winning back the Senate will be reduced to ZERO.
In other words, defeating Jon Ossoff virtually guarantees that President Trump has a Republican Senate for his entire second term. Isn’t that worth a few bucks to you? Maybe even a little more?
Now look – if you can’t afford to contribute financially, I completely get it. If all you can do right now is read this email and send a prayer or two my way, I am deeply grateful for your support. I mean that from the bottom of my heart.
If you can do that AND pitch in, it would really make a difference in the most important race in the country.
Every dollar you give helps me reach every corner of this state, fire up our base, and cut hard-hitting ads that don’t pull any punches about Jon Ossoff’s record.[PLEASE DONATE HERE

Even noble movements can have massive flaws that undermine their stated objectives. The purpose of the pro-life movement is to save children from death while in their mother’s womb. However, for many, the legislative agenda doesn’t include equal protection rights for the unborn child.
This is where the abolitionist movement comes in! To abolish abortion by legislatively affirming that the 14th Amendment protections include unborn children.
This above episode features Bradley Pierce. Bradley is a Constitutional Attorney and the president of Foundation to Abolish Abortion and Abolish Abortion Texas. Currently, the Foundation to Abolish Abortion has legislation in Michigan introduced by Rep. Josh Schriver H.B. 4671 “Justice for Babies in the Womb Act”. clean_body: With less than 3 weeks until the NYC mayoral election, the billionaires are doing exactly what they promised | | | Peter, With less than 3 weeks until the NYC mayoral election, the billionaires are doing exactly what they promised: dumping as much money as possible into defeating Zohran Mamdani. Yesterday, Politico reported that pro-Trump billionaire Bill Ackman just donated $1 million to an anti-Mamdani super PAC.1 And hedge-fund CEO Daniel Loeb pitched in another $100,000 on top of it. This is how the upper echelons of political power operate, Peter. They know they can’t beat Zohran on the issues that matter to New Yorkers — like affordability and public transportation — so they resort to the only thing they have left: mountains and mountains of cash. But we already defeated these billionaires — and Bill Ackman’s $500,000 donation — in the primary. And in 19 days, we have a chance to do it again. We’ve been saying it all year, but it bears repeating: Andrew Cuomo and Donald Trump are birds of a feather. They operate in the same elite circles, with the same donors, consultants, and pundits cheering them on. And at a time when ICE is abducting American citizens off the streets, and Donald Trump is trying to prosecute political opponents — like NY Attorney General and WFP champion Tish James2 — Andrew Cuomo is more focused on garnering support from pro-Trump donors than standing up to Trump himself. Compare that to Zohran Mamdani, who earlier this week, held a rally alongside thousands of working class people, calling for a safer, more affordable New York City. And even used the opportunity to give Tish James a platform in the face of Trump’s attacks.3 That’s the kind of leadership New Yorkers deserve. And on November 4th, we have a chance to prove it for the world to see. But these final three weeks won’t be easy, and we need all the help we can get. Fellow American,

I’ve been on the road — _a lot._

From San Antonio to Floresville, to Karnes City and Seguin — every mile of TX-35 has a story, and every conversation reminds me why we’re fighting to flip this seat.

**But campaigning isn’t glamorous.**
